items.detail: Full-duplex spoken dialogue systems significantly advance over traditional turn-based dialogue systems, as they allow simultaneous bidirectional communication, closely mirroring human-human interactions. However, achieving low latency and natural interactions in full-duplex dialogue systems remains a significant challenge, especially considering human conversation dynamics such as interruptions, backchannels, and overlapping speech. In this paper, we introduce a novel End-to-End GPT-based model OmniFlatten for full-duplex conversation, capable of effectively modeling the complex behaviors inherent to natural conversations with low latency. To achieve full-duplex communication capabilities, we propose a multi-stage post-training scheme that progressively adapts a text-based large language model (LLM) backbone into a speech-text dialogue LLM, capable of generating text and speech in real time, without modifying the architecture of the backbone LLM. The training process comprises three stages: modality alignment, half-duplex dialogue learning, and full-duplex dialogue learning. Throughout all training stages, we standardize the data using a flattening operation, which allows us to unify the training methods and the model architecture across different modalities and tasks. Our approach offers a straightforward modeling technique and a promising research direction for developing efficient and natural end-to-end full-duplex spoken dialogue systems. Audio samples of dialogues generated by OmniFlatten can be found at this web site (https://omniflatten.github.io/).
items.title_zh: OmniFlatten：无缝语音对话的端对端GPT模型
items.detail_zh: 完全繁复的口语对话系统比传统的回合式对话系统大有进步，因为它们可以同时进行双向交流，密切地反映人与人之间的互动。然而，在全复式对话系统中实现低延迟和自然互动仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是考虑到人的对话动态，如中断、后通道和重叠的言论。在本文中，我们引入了以端对端GPT为基础的小说模型OmniFlatten，用于全复式对话，能够有效模拟低纬度的自然对话所固有的复杂行为。为了实现全方位的交流能力，我们提出一个多阶段的后培训计划，将基于文本的大型语言模型(LLM)主干逐步改编为语音-文本对话LLM，能够实时生成文本和语音，而不修改主干LLM的结构。培训过程包括三个阶段：模式调整、半复式对话学习和全复式对话学习。在所有培训阶段，我们使用一个平整操作使数据标准化，使我们能够统一不同模式和任务的训练方法和示范结构。我们的方法为发展高效的、自然的、端到端的完全复杂的口语对话系统提供了直接的建模技术和有希望的研究方向。在该网站(https://omniflatten.github.io/)可以找到OmniFlatten生成的对话框的音频样本。

items.detail: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. Existing methods either introduce artifacts when fusing inconsistent multi-view predictions or struggle to preserve fine details through implicit image-feature conditioning. To resolve these challenges, we introduce SUPRA-Tex, built on the principle of decoupling visible-material estimation, surface alignment, and observation-guided 3D completion. This division of labor allows the 3D generator, trained on limited 3D data, to focus its capacity on preserving visible evidence and completing unobserved surfaces. Specifically, we first train an MLLM-based image editing model to predict lighting-separated PBR maps in the reference view. We then project these maps onto the visible surface and encode them with the pretrained material VAE encoder into native observation latents that share the generation target's latent space. An interleaved flow transformer holds these latents as fixed, read-only anchors while alternating unobserved-region and full-surface updates to generate complete material latents. This design achieves super-alignment with the reference, delivering What You See Is What You Get fidelity on visible regions and coherent completion on unobserved surfaces. Trained solely on public datasets, SUPRA-Tex achieves SOTA performance in both geometry-conditioned texturing and end-to-end asset generation, matching or even exceeding leading commercial systems on in-the-wild images. Project page: https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/
items.title_zh: SUPRA-TEX：带有超对齐纹理的 3D 生成
items.detail_zh: 单图像 3D 生成旨在将一个给定的 3D 网格以可燃材料着装，同时忠实地保存一个参考图像的视觉细节。现有方法要么在调和不一致的多视图预测时引入文物，要么通过隐含的图像特性条件来努力保存细微细节。为了应对这些挑战，我们采用了SUPRA-Tex，其基础是可视材料估算、表面对齐和观察制导3D完成脱钩的原则。这种分工使得经过有限3D数据培训的3D生成器能够将其能力集中于保存可见证据和完成无法观察的表面。具体而言，我们首先培训一个基于MLLM的图像编辑模型，在参考视图中预测照明分离的PBR地图。然后把这些地图投射到可见的表面 用预先训练过的材料 VAE编码器 编码成原生观测潜伏体 共享生成目标潜伏空间 间叶流变压器将这些潜伏物作为固定的、只读的锚，同时交替进行未观测区域和全表面更新，以产生完整的物质潜伏物。这个设计实现了与参考物的超调和，在可见区域上传递你所看到的是忠诚的事物，在看不见的表面上连贯完成。 SUPRA-Tex只接受公共数据集的培训，在几何条件的纹理和端到端资产生成方面都实现了SOTA的性能，比对甚至超过了在闪烁的图像上领先的商业系统。项目网页：https://supra-3d.github.io/supratex/

items.title: Securing the AI Agent: A Unified Framework for Multi-Layer Agent Red Teaming
items.subtitle: The fast growth of open-source AI infrastructure, from model serving engines and agent platforms to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem and the language models themselves, has outpaced the security tooling available to defend it. items.detail: The fast growth of open-source AI infrastructure, from model serving engines and agent platforms to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem and the language models themselves, has outpaced the security tooling available to defend it. We present AI-Infra-Guard, an open-source framework that organizes AI red teaming around a single observation: the attack surface of an AI agent is stratified across layers (infrastructure, protocol/tool, agent behavior, and model), and no single detection paradigm fits all of them. The framework therefore matches a paradigm to each layer, from deterministic rule matching over 75+ AI components and 1{,}400+ vulnerability rules, through LLM-driven agentic auditing of MCP servers and agent-skill packages and multi-turn black-box agent red teaming, to a jailbreak harness with 26+ attack operators over sixteen datasets. To our knowledge it is the only open-source framework to span all of these, including supply-chain auditing of the agent skills that increasingly extend AI agents. We release AI-Infra-Guard as open source so that layer-paradigm matching can serve as a practical foundation for agent security and a shared base for the community to build on.
items.title_zh: 保障人工智能代理：多层代理红色团队统一框架
items.detail_zh: 开源AI基础设施的快速发展，从模型服务引擎和代理平台，到模型背景协议(MCP)生态系统和语言模型本身，都超过了可用于防御它的安全工具。我们提出AI-Infra-Guard，这是一个开源框架，它组织AI红色团队围绕一个单一的观察：AI代理的攻击表面分层分层(基础设施，协议/工具，代理行为，以及模型)，没有一个单一的检测范式适合所有这些。因此，框架将一个范式与每一层相匹配，从确定规则比75+ AI组件和1{，}400+脆弱性规则，通过LLM驱动的代理审计MCP服务器和代理技能包以及多回合黑箱代理红色组合，到26+攻击操作员超过16个数据集的越狱控制带。据我们所知，这是涵盖所有这一切的唯一开放源码框架，包括对代理技能进行供应链审计，从而日益扩展AI代理。我们释放AI-Infra-Guard作为开放源代码，这样层-paradigm匹配就可以作为代理安全的实际基础和共享的基础，让社区在此基础上更进一步。

items.detail: The advent of 1-bit large language models (LLMs), led by BitNet b1.58, has spurred interest in ternary LLMs. Despite this, research and practical applications focusing on efficient edge inference for ternary LLMs remain scarce. To bridge this gap, we introduce Bitnet.cpp, an inference system optimized for BitNet b1.58 and ternary LLMs. Given that mixed-precision matrix multiplication (mpGEMM) constitutes the bulk of inference time in ternary LLMs, Bitnet.cpp incorporates a novel mpGEMM library to facilitate sub-2-bits-per-weight, efficient and lossless inference. The library features two core solutions: Ternary Lookup Table (TL), which addresses spatial inefficiencies of previous bit-wise methods, and Int2 with a Scale (I2_S), which ensures lossless edge inference, both enabling high-speed inference. Our experiments show that Bitnet.cpp achieves up to a 6.25x increase in speed over full-precision baselines and up to 2.32x over low-bit baselines, setting new benchmarks in the field. Additionally, we expand TL to element-wise lookup table (ELUT) for low-bit LLMs in the appendix, presenting both theoretical and empirical evidence of its considerable potential. Bitnet.cpp is publicly available at https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet/tree/paper , offering a sophisticated solution for the efficient and practical deployment of edge LLMs.
items.title_zh: Bitnet.cpp：特尔纳里LLMs的高效边缘推论
items.detail_zh: 由 BitNet b1.58 牵头的1位大语言模型(LLM)的出现，激发了对ternary LLMs的兴趣。尽管如此，侧重于三边法学硕士的有效边缘推论的研究和实际应用仍然很少。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了Bitnet.cpp，一个为BitNet b1.58和ternary LLMs优化的推论系统。鉴于混合精度矩阵乘法(mpGEMM)构成Ternary LLMs的大部分推论时间， Bitnet.cpp 包含了一款新的 mpGEMM 库来方便子-2位/人/人/人/人/人的推论。该库有两个核心解决方案：Trinary Lookup Table(TL)，它解决了以前位取方法的空间效率低下问题；和I2 S的Int2，它确保了无损失的边缘推论，两者都有利于高速推论。我们的实验显示，Bitnet.cpp比全精度基线达到6.25x增速，比低位基线达到2.32x增速，为球场设定了新的基准。此外，我们还将TL扩展为附录中低位 LLMs 的元素取向表(ELUT)，提出了其巨大潜力的理论和经验证据。 Bitnet.cpp可在https://github.com/microsoft/BitNet/tree/paper上公开查阅，为有效实际部署边缘有限责任公司提供了一个复杂的解决方案。

items.detail: Scaling data, diversity and model capacity has improved embodied learning in physical environments, where diverse experiences remain grounded in shared physical laws. Whether these gains extend to virtual worlds with different visual styles, dynamics, controls, and objectives remains unclear. We investigate this question through a controlled study of continued pre-training (CPT) across three axes: data volume, diversity, and model size. Our 120 training configurations span four model sizes from 0.8B to 27B, six data budgets from 50 to 1,600 hours, and five mixtures ranging from Minecraft-only data to diverse multi-world corpora. We assess performance and generalization using three-level validation losses and gameplay benchmarks from in-corpus worlds to unseen worlds. Our results show: (1) more data improves in-corpus performance, diversity improves transfer to related worlds with limited gains in distant worlds, and model size improves data efficiency but generalizes worse to distant worlds under single-world training; (2) we observe an early interface phase with broad cross-world benefits and a later world phase with gains narrowed to in-corpus and related worlds, and fit an empirical scaling law relating validation loss to data volume, diversity and model size; and (3) our models are competitive with Minecraft specialists and frontier models in 3D worlds, and perform best in real-time settings. However, the limits of imitation and persistent gaps in distant worlds suggest that building generalist embodied agents requires richer training stages beyond continued pre-training.

items.detail: Agent-evolution methods use execution feedback to improve prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration, but their implementations often rebuild the same experimental machinery. We present RSIHub, an open-source framework for building, comparing, and extending these methods on shared infrastructure. Recipes compose reusable operators and declare mutable resources; RSIHub supplies execution, evaluation, recovery, and lineage. Researchers can focus on evolution policy while evaluation stays outside the mutable surface and results remain tied to candidates and evaluation conditions. We instantiate AHE, Hyperagents, A-Evolve, and GEPA without modifying the framework core, keeping method-specific logic in recipes and operators. We evaluate them with MiniSWE and Codex on Terminal Bench 2 and τ^3 Banking under fixed model and evaluator configurations. The largest observed overall pass@1 gain is 13.5 percentage points, while method rankings vary across settings and optimization gains do not always transfer to held-out tasks. RSIHub provides a common protocol for comparing evolution policies, inspectable candidate histories, and reusable components for developing new methods.
items.title_zh: RSIHub：代理演进方法的可编译框架
items.detail_zh: 代理演化方法利用执行反馈来改善快感，技能，工具，和管弦乐，但其执行往往会重建同一种实验机械。我们提出RSIHub，这是一个用于建设、比较和扩展这些方法的开放源码框架。食谱由可重复使用的运算符组成，并声明可变资源；RSIHub提供执行，评价，恢复和分行。研究人员可以注重进化政策，而评价则不局限于可变表面，结果仍与候选人和评价条件挂钩。我们即时分析AHE、Hyperagents、A-Evolve和GEPA，不修改框架核心，在配方和操作器中保持特定方法的逻辑。我们用MiniSWE和Codex在2号终端座椅和XQ3银行业进行评估，采用固定模式和评估结构。观察到的总通过率最大@1增益为13.5个百分点，而方法排名则因设置而异，优化收益并不总是转移到被搁置的任务上。 RSIHub为比较进化政策提供了一个共同的协议，可检查候选历史，以及开发新方法的可再使用组件。

items.detail: Discrete visual tokens represent vision in a discrete form analogous to language, offering a native interface for multimodal modeling under a shared next-token prediction objective. However, quantization error is widely assumed to cause unavoidable semantic loss, fundamentally limiting the semantic fidelity of discrete visual tokens and positioning continuous visual representations as an intrinsic upper bound. Using multimodal understanding as a proxy for semantic fidelity, we revisit this assumption and find quantization error unreliable, as discrete representations with substantially larger errors can achieve better understanding. Instead, the effective bit budget of discrete indices emerges as a key determinant of downstream performance. However, existing quantizers eventually saturate as additional codebooks contribute progressively less semantic information. As one approach to alleviating this saturation, we introduce Factorized Vector Quantization, which quantizes complementary, fixed-dimensional views of the visual feature with symmetric parallel codebooks. It continues to improve at larger bit budgets, ultimately matching continuous visual representations in multimodal understanding. Trained on industrial-scale multimodal data, our model achieves state-of-the-art performance among discrete-representation models, outperforming UniAR and Emu3-Chat by 22.8% and 59.2%, respectively, on a nine-metric average. To our knowledge, it is also the first discrete-representation model competitive with strong continuous-representation models such as Qwen3-VL, including on fine-grained OCR tasks. We further identify the key principles and a practical recipe enabling this competitiveness. These results and insights support the potential of discrete visual representations to underpin large-scale native multimodal foundation models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ
items.title_zh: Discrete Tokens能否作为视觉信号的无意识地表达？
items.detail_zh: 分明的视觉符号以类似于语言的离散形式代表了视觉，在共同的下接预测目标下为多式联运模型提供了本土界面。然而，大量认为量化错误会造成不可避免的语义损失，从根本上限制了离散视觉符号的语义忠诚性，并将连续视觉表现定位为内在的上界。使用多模式理解作为语义忠诚的代名词，我们重新审视这一假设，发现量化错误不可靠，因为有大得多错误的离散表达可以实现更好的理解。相反，离散指数的有效比特预算是下游业绩的一个关键决定因素。然而，现有的四分解器最终会饱和，因为额外的编码本会逐渐减少语义信息。作为缓解这种饱和性的一种方法，我们引入了因果化的矢量分量法，它用对称相平行的密码本来将视觉特征的互补的，固定维度的视角进行量化。它在更大的零用量预算中继续得到改进，最终与多式联运中持续的视觉表现相匹配。在工业规模的多模式数据培训方面，我们的模型在离散代表模型中取得了最先进的业绩，在9度平均比UniAR和Emu3-Chat分别高出22.8%和59.2%。据我们所知，这也是第一个独立代表模式，具有强大的连续代表模式，如Qune3-VL，包括精细的OCR任务。我们进一步确定了促进这种竞争力的关键原则和实际办法。这些成果和见解支持了分散的视觉表现支持大规模本土多模式基础模型的潜力。守则和模型见https://github.com/hustvl/FVQ。

items.title: Raven: The Harness of Harnesses for Composable Agentic Intelligence

items.detail: As large language models advance, AI agents are moving beyond isolated, domain-specific tasks toward long-horizon, cross-domain workflows. This transition exposes two challenges: increasing harness complexity makes manual design difficult to scale, while tighter coupling to specific domains limits the generality of a single harness. The central question thus shifts from how to engineer a stronger harness for one domain to how to autonomously construct specialized harnesses, improve them through experience, and orchestrate them across domains. We introduce Raven, The Harness of Harnesses, an open-source multi-agent ecosystem that automatically constructs and evolves modular harnesses for specific models and domains, treating each executable model--harness pair as a composable unit of intelligence. To support an All-Domain Collaboration Network, its Host Agent decomposes goals, matches subtasks to specialized agents, coordinates execution dependencies, and integrates results, while a host archive and EverOS preserve experience across tasks and Skill Forge makes that experience available as reusable procedures. Our theory establishes sufficient conditions for such composition to expand reliable task coverage beyond that of the available individual agents under a shared resource budget. On complex and long-horizon tasks, Raven significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art agent systems, pushing the frontier of composable agentic intelligence.
items.title_zh: Raven：利用哈内斯为可编译的代理智能
items.detail_zh: 随着大型语言模型的推进，AI代理正在超越孤立的，专有域的任务，转向长视野，跨域工作流程。这一过渡暴露了两个挑战：日益复杂的利用使得人工设计难以规模化，而与具体领域的更紧密的结合限制了单一的利用的通用性。因此，中心问题从如何为一个领域设计更强大的工具转向如何自主地建造专门工具，通过经验改进这些工具，并在各个领域加以协调。我们引入了Raven， The Harnesses，一个开源的多剂生态系统，它自动构建和演化特定模型和域的模块化带，将每个可执行的模型-harness配对作为可调和的智能单元。为了支持一个全域协作网络，其主机代理会分解目标，将子任务匹配到专门代理，协调执行依赖，并整合结果，而主机档案和EverOS则保存跨任务的经验，Skill Forge使该经验成为可重复使用的程序。我们的理论为这种构成提供了充分的条件，以扩大可靠的任务范围，使其超出共享资源预算下现有个别代理人的任务范围。在复杂而长的视野任务上，雷文显著地超越了最先进的特工系统，推动了可复合的特工智能的前沿。

items.detail: Long-horizon agents compact their history to continue within a finite context window, but a textual summary alone may not support every subsequent decision. We introduce REMORY, a neural memory network that supplements the summary with a bounded sequence of soft memory tokens. Given the history and summary, the network learns to generate tokens that help a frozen LLM approximate the continuation it would produce with the full history. The tokens are conditioned on the summary and appended after it, forming an analogue of a residual connection along the sequence dimension. On SummHay, REMORY improves source attribution at nearly unchanged insight coverage and approaches the full-context joint score using only 5.2% of the input positions. Across long-horizon agent benchmarks, Qwen3.8-27B and GLM-5.3-Flash show consistent gains with residual memory. Both models also exhibit substantially fewer repeated tool outputs and tool errors on BrowseComp and Terminal-Bench 2.1.
items.title_zh: REMORY：学习残余内存用于背景缩合
items.detail_zh: 长视线代理人将自己的历史压缩在一个有限的上下文窗口中继续，但单是文字摘要可能不能支持以后的每一项决定。我们介绍REMORY，一个神经记忆网络，以软记忆符号的限定序列来补充摘要。鉴于历史和摘要，该网络学会生成一些符号，帮助冻结的LLM大致显示它将产生的完整历史的延续。符号以摘要为条件，并附在其之后，沿序列维形成一个剩余连接的类似物。在SummHay上，REMORY在近乎不变的洞察力覆盖下改进了源属性，并使用5.2%的输入位置接近全文联合得分。纵观长视剂基准，Qune3.8-27B和GLM-5.3-Flash在剩余内存方面显示出一致的收益。两种模型在浏览器Comp和终端-Bench 2.1上显示的重复工具输出和工具错误也大大减少。

items.detail: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.

items.detail: Feed-forward models accurately estimate camera motion and 3D geometry from short video windows. However, computational and memory costs prevent direct inference on sequences containing thousands of frames. Long videos must therefore be processed as overlapping chunks. This division produces independent local reconstructions with inconsistent coordinate frames and duplicate estimates of shared cameras. Achieving global consistency requires propagating constraints from adjacent overlaps and distant revisits across the sequence. This requirement naturally motivates pose graph optimization. However, the choice of graph level creates a trade-off. Chunk-level graphs efficiently resolve scale drift and close large loops. Yet, their rigid transformations cannot correct internal errors or conflicting frame predictions. Conversely, frame-level optimization offers local flexibility, but scaling it globally is computationally expensive and can break metric scale. HiP3R resolves this trade-off using a hierarchical pose graph. HiP3R first optimizes a robust chunk-level Sim(3) graph to establish the global layout and scale. It then holds this layout fixed and estimates one shared SE(3) camera per frame, turning overlapping window predictions into a single trajectory. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of HiP3R in improving camera trajectories and 3D reconstruction. Our method applies to both chunk-based and streaming backends without additional training or fine-tuning. The codes are available at https://kkakkkka.github.io/HiP3R.
items.title_zh: HiP3R：为长视立体重建绘制分级相扑图
items.detail_zh: Feed-forward模型从短视频窗口准确估计相机运动和3D几何。然而，计算成本和内存成本阻止了对包含上千帧的序列的直接推论。因此，长时间的录像必须作为重叠块处理。该处进行独立的当地重建，坐标框架不一致，共用相机的估计数重复。要实现全球一致性，就必须宣传来自相邻重叠的制约，并在整个序列中遥远地重新审视。这一要求自然会激发图的优化。然而，图级的选择会产生取舍。春克级图能高效地解决尺度漂移并关闭大回路。然而，它们的刚性转变无法纠正内部错误或相冲突的帧预测。反之，帧级优化可以提供当地的灵活性，但在全球范围进行升级成本高昂，可以打破公制尺度。 HiP3R用分级平面图解决了这种取舍。 HiP3R首先优化了坚固的块级Sim(3)图来建立全局布局和尺度。然后它固定这种布局，并估计每帧一台共享的SE(3)相机，将相重叠的窗口预测转换为单一轨迹。跨越多个基准的实验证明了HiP3R在改进相机轨迹和3D重建方面的有效性。我们的方法既适用于以块为基础的后端，也适用于不经过额外训练或微调的流后端。这些代码可查阅https://kkakkka.github.io/HiP3R。

items.detail: Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on large-scale multimodal datasets encode rich visual and linguistic knowledge, making them a strong foundation for robotics. Rather than training robotic policies from scratch, recent approaches adapt VLMs into vision-language-action (VLA) models that enable natural language-driven perception and control. However, existing VLAs are typically massive--often with billions of parameters--leading to high training costs and limited real-world deployability. Moreover, they rely on academic and industrial datasets, overlooking the growing availability of community-collected data from affordable robotic platforms. In this work, we present SmolVLA, a small, efficient, and community-driven VLA that drastically reduces both training and inference costs, while retaining competitive performance. SmolVLA is designed to be trained on a single GPU and deployed on consumer-grade GPUs or even CPUs. To further improve responsiveness, we introduce an asynchronous inference stack decoupling perception and action prediction from action execution, allowing higher control rates with chunked action generation. Despite its compact size, SmolVLA achieves performance comparable to VLAs that are 10x larger. We evaluate SmolVLA on a range of both simulated as well as real-world robotic benchmarks and release all code, pretrained models, and training data.
items.title_zh: SmolVLA：经济适用和高效机器人的愿景-语言-行动模型
items.detail_zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)在大规模多式联运数据集上预训，编码了丰富的视觉和语言知识，使其成为机器人学的坚实基础。近期的方法不是从零开始培训机器人政策，而是将VLMs改造为视觉语言动作(VLA)模型，使自然语言驱动的感知和控制成为可能。然而，现有的志愿军通常规模很大，往往有数十亿个参数，导致培训费用高昂，实际世界部署能力有限。此外，它们依靠学术和工业数据集，忽略了社区从负担得起的机器人平台收集的越来越多的数据。在这项工作中，我们介绍了SmolVLA，这是一个小型、高效和社区驱动的VLA，它大大减少了培训和推论费用，同时保留了竞争性业绩。 SmolVLA的设计是在单一GPU上进行训练，并部署在消费级GPU甚至CPU上。为了进一步提高反应能力，我们引入了一个同步推论堆栈，将感知和行动预测与动作执行脱钩，从而能够用块状动作生成来提高控制率。尽管SmolVLA的体积比较紧凑，但能达到与10x更大的VLA相当的性能。我们用一系列模拟和现实世界的机器人基准来评估SmolVLA，并发布所有代码，预先训练的模型和培训数据。

items.detail: Generating images beyond the training resolution of Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remains challenging, as the number of tokens grows rapidly with resolution, full attention becomes expensive, and outputs often suffer from structural distortions and degraded detail. We identify uniform full attention as the common source of both problems. Attending to all tokens at every step causes quadratic cost and exposes the model to more tokens and relative distances beyond the training range, pushing the model out of distribution. We observe that attention's effective receptive field narrows during denoising, from global in early steps that form structure to local in later steps that refine details. We propose AReA, a training-free attention mechanism whose receptive field evolves from coarse to fine, following the denoising progression. In early steps, AReA applies cross-scale coarse attention over downsampled keys and values, capturing global context, while in later steps it applies local attention within progressively shrinking windows. Without additional parameters or training, experiments show that AReA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art training-free baselines across target resolutions and different models, while also being faster and more efficient.
items.title_zh: AReA：高效高分辨率分解变压器的可适应受体-现场注意
items.detail_zh: 生成超出"分化变形器"(Difusion Transformers (DiTs))训练分辨率的图像仍然具有挑战性，因为信使数量随分辨率而迅速增长，充分关注变得昂贵，产出往往会受结构扭曲和细节退化之苦。我们认为，统一充分关注是这两个问题的共同根源。在每一个步骤上注意所有符号都会造成四相成本，使模型暴露出更多的符号并比训练范围更远，将模型推出分发范围。我们看到，注意力的有效可接受性领域在消遣期间缩小，从早期形成结构的全球步骤到后来完善细节的地方步骤。我们提议建立无培训关注机制，该机制的接受领域在取消提名后从粗糙演变为精细。在早期步骤中，AReA对被下取样的密钥和值运用了跨尺度粗放的注意，捕捉了全局背景，而后期步骤则在逐渐收缩的窗口中运用了局部的注意。没有额外的参数或培训，实验表明，AReA在目标分辨率和不同模型方面一贯超过最新无培训基线，同时也更快、更有效率。

items.detail: Educational foundation models must solve problems, understand curriculum structure, diagnose learner difficulties, and provide appropriate instructional support. Existing educational language models often focus on either problem solving or tutoring, with training mixtures organized by source or task rather than capability. We present OmniEdu, an open family of foundation models for K-12 learning and teaching. Its instruction-tuning corpus combines over 100 educational resources and general instruction sources, organized around four capabilities: subject competence, curriculum grounding, diagnostic reasoning, and pedagogical action and scaffolding. Our pipeline integrates deterministic cleaning, semantic auditing and rewriting, task-specific quality scoring, token-budgeted diversity selection, and pedagogical instruction assignment. It yields 69,999 examples and 15.96M supervised response tokens, including 60,951 education-specific examples. We fine-tune 4B, 9B, and 27B models and evaluate curriculum grounding, K-12 problem solving, and pedagogical tutoring, alongside general capability. Education-oriented tuning consistently improves all three educational benchmark groups across model scales. OmniEdu-27B achieves 63.12% EM and 76.69% F1 on K12-Bench, 85.89% on MathFish, 86.95% on EDUMATH, and 78.74% in MathTutorBench's Scaffold setting. It also achieves the highest Teaching average on LongTutor among the evaluated models, at 3.02. These results demonstrate the value of curated, capability-balanced supervision for adapting general language models to educational tasks spanning problem solving, curriculum understanding, and instructional support.
items.title_zh: OmniEdu：开放的学习和教学基础模式
items.detail_zh: 教育基础模式必须解决问题，了解课程结构，诊断学习者的困难，并提供适当的教学支持。现有的教育语言模式往往侧重于解决问题或辅导，培训混合物按来源或任务而不是能力来安排。我们介绍OmniEdu，一个开放的K-12学习和教学的基础模式家庭。其教学调校法将100多家教育资源和一般教学来源结合起来，围绕四个能力组织：学科能力、课程基础、诊断推理、教学行动和脚手架。我们的管道将确定性清洁、语义审计和重写、特定任务的质量评分、象征性预算的多样性选择以及教学指导任务结合起来。它产生了69 999个实例和15 96M监督反应标志，包括60 951个教育特有实例。我们微调4B、9B和27B模式，评估课程基础、K-12问题的解决和教学辅导以及一般能力。以教育为导向的调整不断改善所有三个教育基准组的示范规模。 OmniEdu-27B在K12-Bench上实现63.12%EM和76.69%F1，在MathFish上达到85.89%，在EDUMATH上达到86.95%，在MathTutor Bench的脚手架设置上达到78.74%。它还在被评价的模型中实现了LongTutor教学平均最高，为3.02。这些结果表明，在使通用语言模式适应解决各种问题、理解课程和提供教学支持等教育任务方面，经过管理、能力平衡的监督很有价值。

items.detail: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image. Building on the self-referential construction of Nested Learning (NL), VisionHOPE realizes this co-evolution through five coupled memories that store content, generate key and value representations, and govern learning rate and retention. These memories evolve jointly as visual context accumulates along each scan. However, directly applying the unconstrained self-referential update to a visual backbone leads to instability. We therefore derive a stability-matched step-size control scheme that combines a soft cap on self-referential injection with a spectral clamp on the retained memory transition, and prove that the resulting memory dynamics are non-expansive along each scan. For two-dimensional feature maps, we adapt NL's chunk formulation by aligning chunks with image rows and columns across four directional scans. The proposed VisionHOPE achieves competitive results on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K, establishing self-modifying learning systems as a practical foundation for general-purpose visual backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE.
items.title_zh: 愿景：视觉背骨作为自我改进的学习系统
items.detail_zh: 视觉骨干已经从Convolutional Neural Networks(CNNs)演变而来，局部聚合到具有全球互动的ViTs(ViTs)，具有投入依赖状态过渡的State-Space Models(SSM)，以及在处理图像的同时适应内在学习者的TTT(TTT)层。通过这一进展，视觉计算越来越适应于每项投入，然而，关于适应的规则基本上仍然由经过培训的骨干部门规定。我们介绍VisionHOPE，这是第一个作为自我改造的学习系统而形成的通用视觉骨干，在这个系统中，模型记忆了什么，它是如何在图像中共同学习的。在Nested Learning(NL)的自我偏好构建的基础上，VisionHOPE通过存储内容，生成关键和价值表述，规范学习率和保留率的五种组合记忆，实现了这种共同演变。这些记忆随着视觉上下文在每次扫描过程中的积累而共同演化。然而，将不受约束的自我优惠更新直接应用到视觉骨干上会导致不稳定。因此，我们得出一个稳定相匹配的阶梯大小控制方案，将自偏性注射的软盖与保留内存过渡的光谱夹结合起来，并证明所产生的内存动态在每次扫描过程中都是非扩展的。对于二维特征图，我们调整NL的块式配方，通过四个方向扫描将块与图像行和列对齐。拟议的VisualHOPE在ImageNet-1K，COCO，ADE20K上取得了竞争结果，建立了自我修改的学习系统，作为通用视觉骨干的实际基础。该代码可在https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE查询。

items.detail: Recently, large language model (LLM) based text-to-speech (TTS) systems have gradually become the mainstream in the industry due to their high naturalness and powerful zero-shot voice cloning capabilities.Here, we introduce the IndexTTS system, which is mainly based on the XTTS and Tortoise model. We add some novel improvements. Specifically, in Chinese scenarios, we adopt a hybrid modeling method that combines characters and pinyin, making the pronunciations of polyphonic characters and long-tail characters controllable. We also performed a comparative analysis of the Vector Quantization (VQ) with Finite-Scalar Quantization (FSQ) for codebook utilization of acoustic speech tokens. To further enhance the effect and stability of voice cloning, we introduce a conformer-based speech conditional encoder and replace the speechcode decoder with BigVGAN2. Compared with XTTS, it has achieved significant improvements in naturalness, content consistency, and zero-shot voice cloning. As for the popular TTS systems in the open-source, such as Fish-Speech, CosyVoice2, FireRedTTS and F5-TTS, IndexTTS has a relatively simple training process, more controllable usage, and faster inference speed. Moreover, its performance surpasses that of these systems. Our demos are available at https://index-tts.github.io.
items.title_zh: IndexTTS：工业一级可控和高效的零热文本对语音系统
items.detail_zh: 最近，基于文字对语音(TTS)的大型语言模型(LLM)系统由于具有较高的自然性和强大的零镜头语音克隆能力，逐渐成为业界的主流。在这里，我们引入了IndexTTS系统，该系统主要基于XTTS和龟模型。我们补充了一些新的改进。具体来说，在汉语情景中，我们采用混合模型方法，将字符和pinyin结合，使多音字符和长尾字符的发音可以控制。我们还与Finite-Scalar Quantization(FSQ)对矢量量量化(VQ)进行了比较分析，用于编码本使用声学语音符号。为了进一步提高语音克隆的效果和稳定性，我们引入了以听素为基础的语音条件编码器，并将语音码解码器替换为BigVGAN2。与XTTS相比，在自然性，内容一致性，以及零镜头语音克隆方面都取得了显著的改善。至于开源软件中流行的TTS系统，如Fish-Speech，CosyVoice2，FireRedTTS和F5-TTS，IndexTTS的训练过程相对简单，使用率比较可控，推论速度更快。此外，其业绩超过了这些系统。我们的演示可在https://index-ts.github.io上查阅。

items.detail: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately 1.86times end-to-end inference speedup and a 66times reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.
items.title_zh: MemT-1.0：实现记忆-内在演变
items.detail_zh: 内存-内在演化需要使内存成为基础模型的内在能力，使其能够不断积累和利用信息。为此，我们引入了MemT-1.0，一种内存基础模型的新架构，将内存内部化，作为模型计算的一部分。 MemT-1.0在Metis上的基础上，使用Gated DeltaNet-2，在每个转弯内有一个稳定的符号级内存更新机制。我们进一步引入了Storage混合物，以扩大本土记忆能力。在精心准备骨干骨干后，我们开发了一个两阶段培训管道，包括持续的培训前培训和培训后培训，并辅之以34B项培训数据以及有效的培训和推断基础设施。我们释放了一个由MemT-1.0-Nano和MemT-1.0-Flash组成的模范家族，并对记忆力和一般能力进行全面的评价。结果表明，它们的平均业绩超过了参数内存基线，并且与检索强化方法保持竞争力，同时在很大程度上保持一般能力。在128K令牌的历史长度上，MemT-1.0-Nano实现了约1.86次的终到终推速度，相对于全上下文KV缓存，持续存储量减少了66次。通过将检索的程序经验内部化，MemT-1.0改进了在代理任务上的任务成功，为内存-内在演化提供了一个实际步骤。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have become an essential infrastructure for Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), yet their lack of well-defined memory management systems hinders the development of long-context reasoning, continual personalization, and knowledge consistency.Existing models mainly rely on static parameters and short-lived contextual states, limiting their ability to track user preferences or update knowledge over extended periods.While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) introduces external knowledge in plain text, it remains a stateless workaround without lifecycle control or integration with persistent representations.Recent work has modeled the training and inference cost of LLMs from a memory hierarchy perspective, showing that introducing an explicit memory layer between parameter memory and external retrieval can substantially reduce these costs by externalizing specific knowledge. Beyond computational efficiency, LLMs face broader challenges arising from how information is distributed over time and context, requiring systems capable of managing heterogeneous knowledge spanning different temporal scales and sources. To address this challenge, we propose MemOS, a memory operating system that treats memory as a manageable system resource. It unifies the representation, scheduling, and evolution of plaintext, activation-based, and parameter-level memories, enabling cost-efficient storage and retrieval. As the basic unit, a MemCube encapsulates both memory content and metadata such as provenance and versioning. MemCubes can be composed, migrated, and fused over time, enabling flexible transitions between memory types and bridging retrieval with parameter-based learning. MemOS establishes a memory-centric system framework that brings controllability, plasticity, and evolvability to LLMs, laying the foundation for continual learning and personalized modeling.
items.title_zh: MemOS：AI系统的内存OS
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)已经成为人工一般智能(AGI)的基本基础设施，然而它们缺乏定义明确的内存管理系统，阻碍了长语推理，持续的个性化和知识一致性的发展。现有的模型主要依靠静态参数和短寿命的上下文状态，限制了它们在长时间内跟踪用户偏好或更新知识的能力。虽然检索-增强的一代(RAG)以简洁的文字介绍外部知识，但它仍然是无国籍的工作，没有生命周期控制或与持续表述相结合。最近的工作从内存结构的角度模拟了LLMs的培训和推导成本，表明在参数内存和外部检索之间引入一个明确的内存层，通过将特定知识外部化，可以大大减少这些成本。除了计算效率之外，法学硕士课程还面临因信息如何在时间和背景上分布而产生的更广泛的挑战，需要能够管理跨越不同时间尺度和来源的多样化知识的系统。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出MemOS，一种将内存视为可管理系统资源的内存操作系统。它统一了纯文本、基于激活的记忆和参数级记忆的表达、时间安排和演变，从而能够以具有成本效益的方式存储和检索。作为基本单元，一个MemCube同时封装内存内容和元数据，如出处和版本。元立方体可以随时间而组成，迁移，并被熔化，使得内存类型和以参数为基础的学习连接检索之间能够灵活过渡。 MemOS建立了一个以记忆为中心的系统框架，为LLMs带来可控性，可塑性和可转性，为持续学习和个性化建模奠定了基础。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems enhance large language models (LLMs) by integrating external knowledge sources, enabling more accurate and contextually relevant responses tailored to user needs. However, existing RAG systems have significant limitations, including reliance on flat data representations and inadequate contextual awareness, which can lead to fragmented answers that fail to capture complex inter-dependencies. To address these challenges, we propose LightRAG, which incorporates graph structures into text indexing and retrieval processes. This innovative framework employs a dual-level retrieval system that enhances comprehensive information retrieval from both low-level and high-level knowledge discovery. Additionally, the integration of graph structures with vector representations facilitates efficient retrieval of related entities and their relationships, significantly improving response times while maintaining contextual relevance. This capability is further enhanced by an incremental update algorithm that ensures the timely integration of new data, allowing the system to remain effective and responsive in rapidly changing data environments. Extensive experimental validation demonstrates considerable improvements in retrieval accuracy and efficiency compared to existing approaches. We have made our LightRAG open-source and available at the link: https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG.
items.title_zh: LightRAG：简单且快速的检索增强生成
items.detail_zh: 检索增强生成(RAG)系统通过整合外部知识来源来增强大型语言模型(LLMS)，从而能够根据用户需求做出更加准确和符合具体情况的反应。然而，现有的RAG系统有重大的局限性，包括依赖统一的数据表示和缺乏对背景的认识，这可能导致答案分散，无法反映复杂的相互依存关系。为了应对这些挑战，我们提议使用LightRAG，将图表结构纳入文本索引和检索过程。这一创新框架采用双层检索系统，加强从低层和高级知识发现中的全面信息检索。此外，将图表结构与矢量表示法结合起来，有助于高效检索相关实体及其关系，大大改善反应时间，同时保持关联性。这一能力通过递增更新算法得到进一步加强，该算法确保了新数据的及时整合，使该系统能够在迅速变化的数据环境中保持效力和反应能力。与现有方法相比，广泛的实验验证表明，检索的准确性和效率有相当大的提高。我们开放了我们的LightRAG的源代码，可在以下链接获取：https://github.com/HKUDS/LightRAG。

items.detail: Agentic coding tools receive goals written in natural language as input, break them down into specific tasks, and write or execute the actual code with minimal human intervention. Central to this process are agent context files ("READMEs for agents") that provide persistent, project-level instructions. In this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 2,303 agent context files from 1,925 repositories to characterize their structure, maintenance, and content. We find that these files are not static documentation but complex, difficult-to-read artifacts that evolve like configuration code, maintained through frequent, small additions. Our content analysis of 16 instruction types shows that developers prioritize functional context, such as build and run commands (62.3%), implementation details (69.9%), and architecture (67.7%). We also identify a significant gap: non-functional requirements like security (14.5%) and performance (14.5%) are rarely specified. These findings indicate that while developers use context files to make agents functional, they provide few guardrails to ensure that agent-written code is secure or performant, highlighting the need for improved tooling and practices.
items.title_zh: 代理 READMEs：代理编码背景文件的实证研究
items.detail_zh: 代理编码工具接收以自然语言写成的目标作为输入，将其细分为具体任务，并在最小的人类干预下编写或执行实际代码。这个过程的核心是代理上下文文件("用于代理的READMEs")，提供持久，项目级指令。在本文中，我们对来自1,925个寄存器的2,303个代理上下文文件进行了第一次大规模的实证研究，以描述其结构、维护和内容。我们发现，这些文件不是静态文件，而是复杂，难以阅读的文物，它们像配置代码一样演化，通过频繁的小添加来维护。我们对16种指令类型的内容分析显示，开发者优先排序功能环境，如构建和运行命令(62.3%)，实施细节(69.9%)，以及架构(67.7%)。我们还发现存在一个重大差距：安保(14.5%)和业绩(14.5%)等不起作用的要求很少得到说明。这些发现表明，开发者虽然使用上下文文件来使代理机功能化，但是他们提供很少的护栏来保证代理机写代码的安全性或性能，突出了改进工具和做法的必要性。

items.detail: People have long dreamed of an assistant that is always there to guide them and remind what they forget, from new dishes to lost keys. Powered by multimodal large language models (MLLMs), egocentric AI assistants on wearable devices are bringing this dream within reach: they see what the user sees and give instructions for user's physical work when necessary. However, testing such assistance is challenging and usually requires real people. The expensive and rare real interaction data leaves a key question unanswered: Can today's MLLMs truly help people in physical world? To answer this question, we propose InteractiveWorld, the first verifiable environment for closed-loop interaction between human and AI assistant. Unlike existing robot-centric simulators, InteractiveWorld lets the assistant guide a human agent who observes the scene, understands instructions, and acts independently. It thus realistically simulates how AI assistant collaborates with human: the assistant instructs, the human acts, and the environment executes actions and updates what they see next. Building on it, we introduce InteractiveBench, the first dynamic benchmark for egocentric AI assistants, with 120 multi-turn tasks across six categories. In each task, the assistant guides the human in real time, and every instruction shapes the outcome, which is scored by verifiable, state-based rewards. Experiments with 12 frontier MLLMs show they are still far from reliable assistants. Even the strongest model, Claude Fable 5.1, achieves at most 20% and 25% on long-horizon Guidance and Planning tasks, respectively. Overall, our work offers a verifiable platform and a rigorous evaluation set, laying a solid foundation for research on interactive MLLM assistants that truly help people in the physical world.
items.title_zh: 互动世界：可验证的人类-儿童环境，以构建更好的互动 MLLM 助理
items.detail_zh: 人们早就梦想有一个助手 指导他们 并提醒他们忘记的东西 从新的菜肴到丢失的钥匙 在多模式大型语言模型(MLLMs)的推动下，可穿戴设备上以自我为中心的AI助手正在使这个梦想伸手：他们看到用户所看到的，并在必要时为用户的身体工作提供指示。然而，测试此类援助具有挑战性，通常需要真正的人。昂贵而稀有的真正互动数据留下了一个关键问题：今天的MLLM能真正帮助实际世界的人吗？为了回答这个问题，我们提出"互动世界"(InteractiveWorld)，这是人类和AI助手之间闭路互动的第一个可核查的环境。与现有的以机器人为中心的模拟器不同，"互动世界"让助理指导一个观察场景，理解指令，独立行动的人类代理。因此，它现实地模拟了AI助理如何与人类合作：助理指导，人类行为，环境执行行动，更新他们接下来看到的。在此基础上，我们引入了"互动奔驰"(Interactive Bench)，这是以自我为中心的AI助手的第一个动态基准，共有120个多回合任务，分为6个类别。在每个任务中，助理实时指导人，每个指令都塑造结果，通过可核查的，基于国家的奖励来打分。 12个前沿的MLLMs的实验显示，它们仍然远远没有可靠的助手。即使是最强的模型克洛德Fable 5.1，在长视线指导和规划任务上分别达到最多20%和25%。总体而言，我们的工作提供了一个可核查的平台和一个严格的评价集，为研究真正帮助实际世界人民的交互式MLLM助手奠定了坚实的基础。

items.detail: Personalized presentation generation requires more than conditioning on a current prompt or template: agents must preserve stable user preferences across tasks, retain newly introduced preferences and constraints during multi-turn revision, and carry out local edits reliably. We propose MemSlides, a hierarchical memory framework for personalized presentation agents that separates long-term memory from working memory and further divides long-term memory into user profile memory and tool memory. User profile memory stores intent-conditioned profiles for round-0 personalization, working memory carries active preferences and session constraints across revision rounds, and tool memory stores reusable execution experience for reliable localized editing. MemSlides pairs this memory design with scoped slide-local revision, so targeted updates act on the smallest affected region instead of repeatedly regenerating the full deck. In controlled experiments, user profile memory improves persona-alignment judgments on a multi-persona, multi-intent profile bank, tool-memory injection improves closed-loop modify behavior in diagnostic matched-pair settings, and qualitative cases illustrate working memory's ability to carryover preferences. Taken together, these results suggest that effective personalization in presentation authoring depends on separating persistent user profiles, session-level working memory, and reusable execution experience across generation and localized revision.
items.title_zh: MemSlides：带有多回合本地修订版的个性化幻灯片生成的分级内存驱动代理框架
items.detail_zh: 个性化的演示文稿生成需要的不仅仅是当前即时或模板的配置：代理商必须维护用户对任务的稳定偏好，在多回合修改时保留新引入的偏好和约束，并可靠地进行本地编辑。我们提出"MemSlides"("MemSlides")，这是个性化演示代理的分级内存框架，将长期内存与工作内存区分开来，并进一步将长期内存分为用户配置内存和工具内存。用户配置内存存储了第0个个性化的意向性配置，工作内存在修订回合之间带有主动的偏好和会话限制，工具内存存储可再用执行经验来进行可靠的本地化编辑。 MemSlides将这个内存设计与范围滑-局部修改相配，因此目标更新在最小受影响区域上进行，而不是反复再生整个甲板。在受控实验中，用户剖析内存改进了对多人，多int的剖析库的个性调整判断，工具模具注入改进了诊断匹配-pair环境中的闭合-loop修改行为，定性案例说明了工作内存的结转偏好能力。综合起来，这些结果表明，编写演示文稿时的有效个性化取决于区分持续用户简介、会话级工作记忆以及跨代和本地化的可重复使用的执行经验。

items.detail: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.
items.title_zh: Looking Ahead：自动视频生成中模拟未来进化
items.detail_zh: 自动视频传播模型会逐块生成视频，但产生可信的续作并不能保证它们能捕捉场景的演进。在教师强迫下，强烈的时间冗余可能让局部视觉连续性成为当前-cunk调试的捷径，降低模拟视觉进化的压力。我们提出未来春克预测(Future Chunk Project，FCP)，这是一个辅助目标，与教师强制的去Noing共同优化，它预言在时间上分开的块，无法进入干扰的视觉环境。直接从训练视频中绘制监督，FCP不需要额外的预先训练的视觉编码器，而自动回转推论保持不变。我们的方法实现了优于标准师资强制自动递解培训的物理合理性，总体培训计算预算较低，凸显了未来Chunk监理对视觉演化模型的效能和效率。有趣的是，我们的可视化表明，FCP培育了一个更有条理的表示空间，对于建立自转式世界模型可能很有价值。

items.detail: Recent advancements in 3D generative modeling have significantly improved the generation realism, yet the field is still hampered by existing representations, which struggle to capture assets with complex topologies and detailed appearance. This paper present an approach for learning a structured latent representation from native 3D data to address this challenge. At its core is a new sparse voxel structure called O-Voxel, an omni-voxel representation that encodes both geometry and appearance. O-Voxel can robustly model arbitrary topology, including open, non-manifold, and fully-enclosed surfaces, while capturing comprehensive surface attributes beyond texture color, such as physically-based rendering parameters. Based on O-Voxel, we design a Sparse Compression VAE which provides a high spatial compression rate and a compact latent space. We train large-scale flow-matching models comprising 4B parameters for 3D generation using diverse public 3D asset datasets. Despite their scale, inference remains highly efficient. Meanwhile, the geometry and material quality of our generated assets far exceed those of existing models. We believe our approach offers a significant advancement in 3D generative modeling.
items.title_zh: 3D 世代的本地和契约结构的后人
items.detail_zh: 最近在3D基因模型化方面的进步大大改进了生成现实主义，然而这个领域仍然受到现有表述的阻碍，这些表述试图用复杂的地形和详细的外观来捕捉资产。本文件介绍了从本地立体数据中学习结构化潜在代表性以应对这一挑战的方法。其核心是一种新的稀疏的阴道结构，称为O-Voxel，是一种omni-voxel代表，它同时编码几何和外观。 O-Voxel可以强力地模拟任意地形，包括开放的，非狂形的，和完全封闭的表面，同时捕捉到超出纹理颜色的全面表面属性，如物理渲染参数。基于O-Voxel，我们设计了Sparse Compression VAE，提供高空间压缩率和紧凑的潜伏空间。我们利用不同的公共三维资产数据集，为三维生成培训由4B参数组成的大规模流量匹配模型。尽管其规模很大，但推断仍然非常有效。与此同时，我们创造的资产的几何和物质质量远远超过现有模型。我们认为，我们的做法在三维基因模型的制作方面取得重大进展。

items.title: SkillOpt: Executive Strategy for Self-Evolving Agent Skills

items.detail: Agent skills today are hand-crafted, generated one-shot, or evolved through loosely controlled self-revision, none of which behaves like a deep-learning optimizer for the skill, and none of which reliably improves over its starting point under feedback. We argue the skill should instead be trained as the external state of a frozen agent, with the same discipline that makes weight-space optimization reproducible. SkillOpt is, to our knowledge, the first systematic controllable text-space optimizer for agent skills: a separate optimizer model turns scored rollouts into bounded add/delete/replace edits on a single skill document, and an edit is accepted only when it strictly improves a held-out validation score. A textual learning-rate budget, rejected-edit buffer, and epoch-wise slow/meta update make skill training stable while adding zero inference-time model calls at deployment. Across six benchmarks, seven target models, and three execution harnesses (direct chat, Codex, Claude Code), SkillOpt is best or tied on all 52 evaluated (model, benchmark, harness) cells and beats every per-cell competitor among human, one-shot LLM, Trace2Skill, TextGrad, GEPA, and EvoSkill skills. On GPT-5.5 it lifts the average no-skill accuracy by +23.5 points in direct chat, by +24.8 inside the Codex agentic loop, and by +19.1 inside Claude Code. Transfer experiments further show that optimized skill artifacts retain value when moved across model scales, between Codex and Claude Code execution environments, and to a nearby math benchmark without further optimization.
items.title_zh: SkillOpt：自我发展代理技能执行战略
items.detail_zh: 今天的代理技能是手工制作的，产生一弹一弹，或者通过松散控制的自译自审来演化，其中没有任何一种表现得像技能的深层学习优化器，没有任何一种在反馈下可靠地改善了它的起点。我们主张技能应该作为冷冻剂的外部状态来训练，具有同样的学科，使得重量空间优化可以再生产。据我们所知，SkillOpt是代理技能的首个系统可控文本空间优化器：一个单独的优化器模型将打分的推出转换成在单一技能文档上绑定的添加/删除/替换编辑，只有在严格改进被搁置的验证分数时才接受编辑。文本学习率预算、拒绝编辑缓冲和划时代的慢/元更新使技能培训稳定，同时在部署时增加零推断时间模型呼叫。在6个基准、7个目标模型和3个执行工具(直接聊天、Codex、Claude Code)中，SkillOpt是最佳的或与所有52个被评价的细胞(模型、基准、带)捆绑在一起的，并击败了人类中每个细胞的每个竞争者、一击LM、Trace2Skill、TextGrad、GEPA和EvoSkill技能。在GPT-5.5上，它通过直接聊天的+23.5分，Codex代理循环的+24.8分和Claude代码的+19.1分提高平均无技能精度。转移实验进一步显示，优化的技能文物在跨模型尺度移动时，在Codex和Claude代码执行环境之间，以及在不进一步优化的情况下，保留到附近的数学基准上的价值。

items.detail: Recent text-to-video diffusion models can generate compelling video sequences, yet they remain silent -- missing the semantic, emotional, and atmospheric cues that audio provides. We introduce LTX-2, an open-source foundational model capable of generating high-quality, temporally synchronized audiovisual content in a unified manner. LTX-2 consists of an asymmetric dual-stream transformer with a 14B-parameter video stream and a 5B-parameter audio stream, coupled through bidirectional audio-video cross-attention layers with temporal positional embeddings and cross-modality AdaLN for shared timestep conditioning. This architecture enables efficient training and inference of a unified audiovisual model while allocating more capacity for video generation than audio generation. We employ a multilingual text encoder for broader prompt understanding and introduce a modality-aware classifier-free guidance (modality-CFG) mechanism for improved audiovisual alignment and controllability. Beyond generating speech, LTX-2 produces rich, coherent audio tracks that follow the characters, environment, style, and emotion of each scene -- complete with natural background and foley elements. In our evaluations, the model achieves state-of-the-art audiovisual quality and prompt adherence among open-source systems, while delivering results comparable to proprietary models at a fraction of their computational cost and inference time. All model weights and code are publicly released.
items.title_zh: LTX-2：高效联合视听基础模型
items.detail_zh: 最近的文字到视频传播模型可以产生令人信服的视频序列，然而它们却保持沉默——缺少音频提供的语义，情感和大气提示。我们采用LTX-2，是一种开源基础模型，能够以统一的方式生成高质量，时间同步的视听内容。 LTX-2由非对称双流变压器组成，具有14B参数的视频流和5B参数的音频流，通过双向音频-视频交叉透视层结合而成，具有时间定位嵌入和跨模式的AdaLN用于共享时序调节。这种结构能够有效培训和推论统一的视听模式，同时分配比音频生成更多的视频生成能力。我们使用多语种文本编码器，以便迅速获得更广泛的理解，并采用一种无模式识别的分类器指导(模式-CFG)机制，以改进视听协调和可控性。 LTX-2除了生成语音外，还产生丰富，连贯的音频音轨，跟踪每个场景的人物，环境，风格和情感——完整地带有自然背景和foley元素。在我们的评价中，该模式实现了最先进的视听质量，并使开源系统迅速遵守，同时以占其计算成本和推断时间的一小部分，提供与专有模式可比的成果。所有模型重量和代码都公开发布。

items.detail: We introduce SANA-Video, a small diffusion model that can efficiently generate videos up to 720x1280 resolution and minute-length duration. SANA-Video synthesizes high-resolution, high-quality and long videos with strong text-video alignment at a remarkably fast speed, deployable on RTX 5090 GPU. Two core designs ensure our efficient, effective and long video generation: (1) Linear DiT: We leverage linear attention as the core operation, which is more efficient than vanilla attention given the large number of tokens processed in video generation. (2) Constant-Memory KV cache for Block Linear Attention: we design block-wise autoregressive approach for long video generation by employing a constant-memory state, derived from the cumulative properties of linear attention. This KV cache provides the Linear DiT with global context at a fixed memory cost, eliminating the need for a traditional KV cache and enabling efficient, minute-long video generation. In addition, we explore effective data filters and model training strategies, narrowing the training cost to 12 days on 64 H100 GPUs, which is only 1% of the cost of MovieGen. Given its low cost, SANA-Video achieves competitive performance compared to modern state-of-the-art small diffusion models (e.g., Wan 2.1-1.3B and SkyReel-V2-1.3B) while being 16x faster in measured latency. Moreover, SANA-Video can be deployed on RTX 5090 GPUs with NVFP4 precision, accelerating the inference speed of generating a 5-second 720p video from 71s to 29s (2.4x speedup). In summary, SANA-Video enables low-cost, high-quality video generation.
items.title_zh: SANA- Video：高效的带块线性扩散变形器的视频生成
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了SANA-Video，是一种小型的传播模型，可以高效生成高达720x1280分辨率和分钟长度的视频。 SANA-Video合成高分辨率，高质量和长的视频，以极快的速度对齐文本视频，可部署在RTX 5090 GPU上。两种核心设计确保了我们高效，高效和长的视频生成：(1) Linear DiT：我们利用线性关注作为核心操作，由于视频生成中处理的大量标语，它比香草关注更有效。 (2)Clock Linear Records的恒定-Memory KV缓存：我们通过使用恒定-memory状态，从线性注意的累积属性中衍生出来，为长视频生成设计区块自递回方法。这个KV缓存以固定的内存成本为全局提供了Linear DiT，从而消除了传统KV缓存的需求，并实现了高效，短时间的视频生成。此外，我们探索有效的数据过滤器和模型培训策略，将64台H100GPU的培训费用缩小到12天，这只占MovieGen成本的1%。鉴于其成本低廉，SANA-Video与现代最先进的小型扩散模型(如Wan 2.1-1.3B和SkyReel-V2-1.3B)相比，实现了竞争性能，同时在测得的纬度方面更快16x。此外，SANA-Video可以以NVFP4精度在RTX 5090GPU上部署，加速了从71秒到29秒(2.4x加速)生成5秒720p视频的推论速度。简而言之，SANA-Video可以实现低成本，高质量的视频生成。

items.title: Qwen3-TTS Technical Report
items.subtitle: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS adopts a dual-track LM architecture for real-time synthesis, coupled with two speech tokenizers: 1) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz is a single-codebook codec emphasizing semantic content, which offers seamlessly integration with Qwen-Audio and enables streaming waveform reconstruction vi
items.detail: In this report, we present the Qwen3-TTS series, a family of advanced multilingual, controllable, robust, and streaming text-to-speech models. Qwen3-TTS supports state-of-the-art 3-second voice cloning and description-based control, allowing both the creation of entirely novel voices and fine-grained manipulation over the output speech. Trained on over 5 million hours of speech data spanning 10 languages, Qwen3-TTS adopts a dual-track LM architecture for real-time synthesis, coupled with two speech tokenizers: 1) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz is a single-codebook codec emphasizing semantic content, which offers seamlessly integration with Qwen-Audio and enables streaming waveform reconstruction via a block-wise DiT. 2) Qwen-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz achieves extreme bitrate reduction and ultra-low-latency streaming, enabling immediate first-packet emission (97,ms) through its 12.5 Hz, 16-layer multi-codebook design and a lightweight causal ConvNet. Extensive experiments indicate state-of-the-art performance across diverse objective and subjective benchmark (e.g., TTS multilingual test set, InstructTTSEval, and our long speech test set). To facilitate community research and development, we release both tokenizers and models under the Apache 2.0 license.
items.title_zh: Qune3-TTS 技术报告
items.detail_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了Qune3-TTS系列，这是一个由先进的多语种，可控，强健，流畅的文本对语音模型组成的家族。 Qune3-TTS支持最先进的3秒语音克隆和基于描述的控制，既允许创造全新的声音，也允许精细地操纵输出语音。 Qune3-TTS对跨越10种语言的500多万小时的语音数据进行了培训，采用双轨LM架构进行实时合成，并配有两种语音示意器： 1) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-25Hz是一个强调语义内容的单码簿编码器，它提供与Qun-Audio的无缝集成，并通过区块化的DiT.2实现流波形重建 2) Qun-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz实现极端比特率的降低和超低纬度流化，通过它的12.5Hz，16层多码簿设计以及轻量因子ConvNet，使得立即的第一包排放(97，ms)成为可能。广泛的实验表明跨越不同客观和主观基准(如TTS多语种测试集，InstructTTSEval，以及我们的长语音测试集)的先进性能。为了促进社区研发，我们根据Apache 2.0许可证发布了标致剂和模型。

items.detail: Precise camera control is essential for cinematic character video generation, yet existing methods struggle to follow large-angle trajectories with combined rotation, translation, and radius variation from arbitrary initial azimuths. Such viewpoint changes also reveal character regions unseen in the initial frame, causing geometric distortions, appearance degradation, and identity drift. To systematically study these coupled challenges, we introduce CLACT, a large-scale Character-centric dataset and benchmark covering diverse Large-Angle Camera Trajectories, with accurate camera geometry and multi-view character observations for training and evaluation. We further propose WorldCast, a framework for world-consistent character video generation under diverse large-angle camera motions. Specifically, we back-project the initial frame into a 3D point cloud using estimated depth, align the point-cloud scale with the target camera trajectory, and render it along the trajectory to obtain explicit geometric guidance and coverage masks. To complement the incomplete character information, we introduce Geometry-Aligned Memory Attention (GAMA). Using relative camera poses estimated jointly from the initial frame and multi-view character anchors, we express anchor and target-view geometry in a common coordinate frame. GAMA uses this geometric alignment to guide the retrieval and injection of view-relevant character features during generation. Evaluations across diverse large-angle camera trajectories demonstrate accurate trajectory following while preserving character geometry, appearance, and identity.
items.title_zh: WorldCast：带有大角相机控制的World-Consist 字符视频生成
items.detail_zh: 精准相机控制对于电影角色视频生成至关重要，然而，现有的方法却挣扎着跟随大角轨迹，结合旋转，翻译，以及由任意初始方位角产生的半径变化。这种观点的改变还揭示出初始框架所看不到的特征区域，造成几何扭曲、外观退化和身份漂移。为了系统地研究这些并存的挑战，我们引入了CLACT，这是一个大型的以字符为中心的数据集和基准，涵盖各种大角相机轨迹，并配有精确相机几何和多视图字符观测，用于培训和评价。我们进一步提出"WorldCast"，即在各种大角相机运动下，为世界一致的人物视频生成提供框架。具体地说，我们利用估计的深度将初始框架投射为3D点云，使点-云尺度与目标相机轨迹相配合，使其沿着轨迹来得到明确的几何取向和覆盖口罩。为了补充不完整的字符信息，我们引入了几何-相通记忆关注(GAMA)。使用相对相机呈现出从初始帧和多视图字符锚地共同估算出来的相机，我们用一个共同的坐标帧来表达锚地和靶地几何。 GAMA使用这种几何校正来指导在生成期间检索并注入与视图相关的字符特征。横跨各种大角相机轨迹的评价显示了准确的轨迹，同时保留了人物几何，外观和身份。

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as long-term interactive agents, yet their limited context windows make it difficult to sustain coherent behavior over extended interactions. Existing memory systems often store isolated records and retrieve fragments, limiting their ability to consolidate evolving user states and resolve conflicts. We introduce EverMemOS, a self-organizing memory operating system that implements an engram-inspired lifecycle for computational memory. Episodic Trace Formation converts dialogue streams into MemCells that capture episodic traces, atomic facts, and time-bounded Foresight signals. Semantic Consolidation organizes MemCells into thematic MemScenes, distilling stable semantic structures and updating user profiles. Reconstructive Recollection performs MemScene-guided agentic retrieval to compose the necessary and sufficient context for downstream reasoning. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval show that EverMemOS achieves state-of-the-art performance on memory-augmented reasoning tasks. We further report a profile study on PersonaMem v2 and qualitative case studies illustrating chat-oriented capabilities such as user profiling and Foresight. Code is available at https://github.com/EverMind-AI/EverMemOS.

To scale training, we develop a multi-stage training recipe together with a staged data pipeline covering video captioning and speech captioning, voice-quality assessment, and reward modeling. To push the frontier of open-source TTS, we release our model weights, fine-tuning code, and an SGLang-based inference engine. The inference engine is production-ready for streaming, achieving an RTF of 0.195 and a time-to-first-audio below 100 ms.Our code and weights are available on GitHub (https://github.com/fishaudio/fish-speech) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/fishaudio/s2-pro). We highly encourage readers to visit https://fish.audio to try custom voices.

items.detail: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
items.title_zh: OpenVL Harness：真实世界视觉代理工具与多式联运内存的使用
items.detail_zh: 多式联运大语言模型(MLLMs)在视觉推理上取得了迅速的进展，然而许多任务需要的证据是单靠内部推理很难获得的：我们对22个基准的控制研究表明，仅仅增加基模型的推论预算只能产生微小的收益。这种任务需要有依据的认知、外部知识和通过各种工具获得的数字测量，其产出必须能够对模型加以解释，并保留各种推理步骤。我们介绍了OpenVLHarness，这是一个围绕能力层和持久的多式联运内存组织的多式联运推理工具。能力层将任务级工具界面与证据渲染相结合，提供对各种后端的一致访问，并将其输出转化为模型可读观测。持续的多模式内存保留了相应的图像、结构化数据和网络参考资料，作为每个查询的可地址文物。一个编码接口在存储数据之上执行生成的程序，使计算能够结合多个工具的结果。这些机制共同支持获得、检查和整理多式联运证据的迭代过程。 OpenVLHarness对22个基准进行了评估，有8个开放和专有骨干，比匹配的无工具基线提高9.7-12.6分，包括+11.2与Qune3-VL-8B，+9.7与Kimi K3，+9.9与GPT-6 Astra。由于GPT-6 Luna在中度推理努力，OpenVLHarness以最大努力7.7-8.5分的功率超过了基准模型Codex和Visual Sketchpad，而其模型-token成本最高为37%。

items.detail: Unified audio-video creation requires a single model capable of text-conditioned joint synthesis, bidirectional cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing across both modalities. Existing methods rely heavily on paired corpora, which are scarce for joint generation and even rarer for editing. Consequently, they are spent learning single-branch generative and editing capabilities that abundant unimodal data could readily teach, rather than on the cross-modal coupling. Furthermore, prevailing systems apply a single shared noise schedule to both modalities, neglecting two critical limitations. First, due to the significant discrepancy in information density, video requires prolonged high noise to organize spatial and motion structure, whereas the sparser audio signal can settle earlier during the synthesis process, the dynamics a uniform schedule might compromise. Second, lockstep denoising leaves asymmetric workflows, such as conditioning on one modality to synthesize or edit another, untrained. We present UniAVC, which addresses both obstacles. It first trains each branch on unimodal dataset to full generative and editing competence, and subsequently dedicates paired data to exploit cross-modal correspondence. Modality-decoupled schedulers meanwhile warp the noise schedule independently from a shared timestep, while subtasks with one clean modality directly supervise asymmetric configurations. These settings respectively enable intent-aware editing, which preserves one modality intact while enlisting it to constrain the other, and post-inference self-refinement, which regenerates only an unsatisfactory branch against an accepted one. UniAVC thus spans multiple creation tasks from a single set of weights without task-specific adapters.
items.title_zh: UniAVC：通过渐进式培训和不对称时间安排来统一制作音频视频
items.detail_zh: 统一音频视频的创建需要一个单一的模式，能够进行文字条件的联合合成，双向交叉模式生成，以及两种模式的指令指导编辑。现有方法严重依赖配对的corpora，它们很少用于联合生成甚至更罕见的编辑。因此，它们花在学习单分支的基因和编辑能力上，这些能力是丰富的单模式数据可以随时传授的，而不是交叉模式的组合。此外，现行系统对这两种模式都采用单一的共享噪音时间表，忽略了两个关键限制。首先，由于信息密度的巨大差异，视频需要长时间的高噪音来组织空间和运动结构，而较稀疏的音频信号可以在合成过程中更早地解决，而统一时间表的动态可能有所妥协。第二，锁步去诺叶不对称的工作流程，如在一个模式上进行调节以合成或编辑另一个，未经训练。我们介绍UniAVC，它处理两个障碍。它首先对单式数据集的每个分支进行培训，使其具备充分的基因和编辑能力，随后将配对数据专门用于利用跨式通信。模式解耦调度器同时将噪声表与共享的时序分开旋转，而带有一种清洁模式的子任务则直接监督不对称配置。这些设置分别使意向意识编辑能够保持一种模式的完整，同时争取它来约束另一种模式，以及推论后自我修饰，这种修饰只能使一个不满意的分支对被接受的分支进行再生。因此，UniAVC从一组没有任务特定适配器的单重中跨越多个创建任务。

items.detail: Interactive video world models require coordinated control over viewing perspectives, character actions, and camera motion. Existing methods typically leave view modes implicit in text captions, conflate action with camera motion, and inject controls through fragmented architectural pathways that capture interdependencies only indirectly. In this work, we present World-in-Context, an interactive world modeling framework powered by In-Context Conditioning (ICC). Rather than relying on specialized conditioning pathways, World-in-Context unifies view, action, and camera controls into explicit tokens contextualized directly within a shared self-attention space. Our formulation reveals that (i) explicit view tokens disentangle conflicting dynamics and unlock emergent view switching from single-view data, while (ii) action and camera inputs play complementary roles in governing local responsiveness and global stability. To preserve temporal continuity across execution intervals, we further introduce Interaction-Transport RoPE (IT-RoPE), parameterizing temporal attention with accumulated control transitions. On WBench, World-in-Context-5B achieves navigation performance on par with 22B EchoWM (81.5 vs. 81.6) and attains a 93.8% perspective-switching success rate, substantially outperforming existing 5B baselines (18.8%). Controlled analyses further demonstrate compounding advantages of World-in-Context under richer conditioning mixtures, favorable data efficiency, and natural applicability to causal rollouts.

items.detail: We present an approach to mitigating the risks of malicious image editing posed by large diffusion models. The key idea is to immunize images so as to make them resistant to manipulation by these models. This immunization relies on injection of imperceptible adversarial perturbations designed to disrupt the operation of the targeted diffusion models, forcing them to generate unrealistic images. We provide two methods for crafting such perturbations, and then demonstrate their efficacy. Finally, we discuss a policy component necessary to make our approach fully effective and practical -- one that involves the organizations developing diffusion models, rather than individual users, to implement (and support) the immunization process.

items.detail_zh: 我们提出了一个减轻大规模传播模型造成的恶意图像编辑风险的办法。关键的想法是免疫图像，使其能抵抗被这些模型所操纵。这种免疫依赖于注射不易察觉的对抗性扰动来打乱目标传播模式的运作，迫使它们产生不切实际的图像。我们提供了两种方法来设计这种扰动，然后展示其效力。最后，我们讨论一个必要的政策组成部分，使我们的方法充分有效和实用 -- -- 一个涉及各组织制定传播模式，而不是个别用户，以执行(和支持)免疫进程。

items.title: LlamaFactory: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ Language Models
items.subtitle: Efficient fine-tuning is vital for adapting large language models (LLMs) to downstream tasks. However, it requires non-trivial efforts to implement these methods on different models. We present LlamaFactory, a unified framework that integrates a suite of cutting-edge efficient training methods. It allows users to flexibly customize the fine-tuning of 100+ LLMs without the need for coding through the built-in web UI LlamaBoard. We empirically validate the efficiency and effectiveness of our framework on language modeling and text generation tasks. It has been released at https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory and already received over 13,000 stars and 1,600 forks.

items.detail: This report presents VibeVoice, a novel model designed to synthesize long-form speech with multiple speakers by employing next-token diffusion, which is a unified method for modeling continuous data by autoregressively generating latent vectors via diffusion. To enable this, we introduce a novel continuous speech tokenizer that, when compared to the popular Encodec model, improves data compression by 80 times while maintaining comparable performance. The tokenizer effectively preserves audio fidelity while significantly boosting computational efficiency for processing long sequences. Thus, VibeVoice can synthesize long-form speech for up to 90 minutes (in a 64K context window length) with a maximum of 4 speakers, capturing the authentic conversational ``vibe'' and surpassing open-source and proprietary dialogue models.
items.detail_zh: 本报告介绍了VibeVoice，这是一种新颖的模型，旨在通过使用近位传播来合成长式语音和多位扬声器，这是一种通过传播自旋生成潜在向量来模拟连续数据的统一方法。为了实现这一点，我们引入了一种新颖的连续语音表示器，与流行的Encodec模型相比，在保持可比性能的同时将数据压缩提高了80倍。标语器有效地保存了音频忠贞性，同时大大提高了处理长序列的计算效率。因此，VibeVoice可以合成最长90分钟的长式语音(在64K上下文窗口长度)，最多4个扬声器，捕捉真实的对白"vibe'，并超越开源和专有的对话模式。

items.detail: Game engines and coding agents can specify the layout, motion, and camera of a scene, yet turning such coarse structure into realistic video requires a renderer that follows the structure and completes the appearance it leaves open. Existing renderers are tied to the representation of one engine, need tens of denoising steps or a costly distillation of their own, and learn from conditions that are not aligned with their target videos. We present SolarRenderer, a structure-conditioned video renderer that adapts a frozen MiniMax-H3 33B backbone with two lightweight LoRAs. Structural videos enter the native reference pathway of the backbone at the positions of the frames they describe, without a type identifier and described only in plain text, so that a single control LoRA follows arbitrary structural representations. Starting from a pretrained four-step LoRA, structure-guided distribution matching renders in four steps, 12.3 times faster than 50-step sampling, while preserving the learned control. A block-causal variant extends the same design to streaming and renders 768p video in real time. To train the model, we build a frame-aligned corpus of 136K clips from game engines, simulators, and YouTube videos. Experiments on an in-distribution test set and a generalization benchmark of 16 structural representations show that SolarRenderer achieves state-of-the-art results across both, and generalizes to 11 unseen representations, including pose skeletons, drawings, and point clouds.
items.title_zh: 太阳能渲染器：极少数阶梯式基因参考渲染
items.detail_zh: 游戏引擎和编码代理可以指定一个场景的布局，运动，和相机，然而将这种粗糙的结构变成现实的视频需要一个遵循结构的渲染器，完成它留下的外观打开。现有的渲染器与一种发动机的表示有关，需要数十个调试步骤或自己的昂贵的蒸馏，并学习与其目标视频不匹配的条件。我们介绍SolarRenderer，一个结构条件化的视频渲染器，它可以改造一个冷冻的MiniMax-H3 33B主干线，有两个轻量级的LORA。结构视频在其描述的框架位置输入主干线的原生参考路径，没有类型标识符，仅在纯文本中描述，因此一个单一的控制LORA遵循任意的结构表示。从预先训练的四步LORA开始，结构制导的分布比对在四个步骤中，比50步的取样速度快12.3倍，同时保留了学到的控制。区块-causal变体将同一设计延伸至流线，实时制作768p视频。为了训练这个模型，我们从游戏引擎、模拟器和YouTube视频中构建了一套由136K片段组成的帧组合。对分布式测试集的实验和16个结构表示式的概括化基准表明，SolarRenderer在两个方面都取得了最先进的结果，并概括到11个看不见的表示式，包括姿势骨架，图画，和点云。

items.detail: Depth sensors are widely deployed across robotic platforms, and advances in fast, high-fidelity depth simulation have enabled robotic policies trained on depth observations to achieve robust sim-to-real transfer for a wide range of tasks. Despite this, representation learning for depth modality remains underexplored compared to RGB, where large-scale foundation models now define the state of the art. To address this gap, we present DeFM, a self-supervised foundation model trained entirely on depth images for robotic applications. Using a DINO-style self-distillation objective on a curated dataset of 60M depth images, DeFM learns geometric and semantic representations that generalize to diverse environments, tasks, and sensors. To retain metric awareness across multiple scales, we introduce a novel input normalization strategy. We further distill DeFM into compact models suitable for resource-constrained robotic systems. When evaluated on depth-based classification, segmentation, navigation, locomotion, and manipulation benchmarks, DeFM achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates strong generalization from simulation to real-world environments. We release all our pretrained models, which can be adopted off-the-shelf for depth-based robotic learning without task-specific fine-tuning. Webpage: https://de-fm.github.io/
items.title_zh: DeFM：机器人深度的学习基金会代表
items.detail_zh: 深度传感器被广泛部署在机器人平台之间，快速而高真实度深度模拟的进步使得接受过深度观测培训的机器人政策能够实现强力的sim-to-real转移，以完成广泛的任务。尽管如此，与RGB相比，深度模式的表达学习仍然没有得到充分的探讨，而RGB的大规模基础模型现在定义了最先进的。为了弥补这一差距，我们介绍了DeFM，这是一种自我监督的基础模型，完全接受关于机器人应用深度图像的培训。 DeFM利用由60M深度图像所编译的数据集上的DINO式自沉目标，学习了几何和语义表达法，将它概括到不同的环境、任务和传感器。为了在多个层面上保持衡量标准的认识，我们引入了一个新的投入正常化战略。我们进一步将DeFM蒸馏成适合资源受限的机器人系统的紧凑模型。在对深度分解，分解，导航，运动，和操纵等基准进行评估时，DeFM实现了最先进的性能，并表现出从模拟到现实世界环境的强烈概括。我们释放所有预先训练过的模型，这些模型可以被现成地采用，用于深度机器人学习，而无需对特定任务进行微调。网页：https://de-fm.github.io/

items.detail: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly deployed in enterprise search and document-centric assistants, where responses must be grounded in long and complex source materials. In practice, verifying that generated answers faithfully reflect retrieved documents is difficult: large language models can check long contexts but are too slow and costly for interactive services, while lightweight classifiers operate within strict context limits and frequently miss evidence outside truncated passages. We present the design of a real-time verification component integrated into a production RAG pipeline that enables full-document grounding under latency constraints. The system processes documents up to 32K tokens and employs adaptive inference strategies to balance response time and verification coverage across workloads. We describe the architectural decisions, operational trade-offs, and evaluation methodology used to deploy the verifier, and show that full-context verification substantially improves detection of unsupported responses compared with truncated validation. Our experience highlights when long-context verification is necessary, why chunk-based checking often fails in real documents, and how latency budgets shape model design. These findings provide practical guidance for practitioners building reliable large-scale retrieval-augmented applications. (Model, benchmark, and code: https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)
items.title_zh: 快速而忠实：长文件检索强化生成系统的实时验证
items.detail_zh: 在企业搜索和以文件为中心的助理中，越来越多地部署检索增强的生成(RAG)，这些助理的反应必须基于长期和复杂的原始材料。在实践中，核查生成的答案忠实地反映检索到的文档是困难的：大型语言模型可以检查较长的上下文，但对于交互服务来说太慢和成本太高，而轻量级分类器在严格的上下文限制下运行，经常在截断的段落之外错过证据。我们提出将实时核查部分纳入生产RAG管道的设计，以便在暂时性限制下全面铺设文件。该系统处理多达32K令牌的文件，并采用适应性的推断战略，以平衡反应时间和工作量的核查范围。我们描述了用于部署核查员的建筑决定、业务权衡和评价方法，并表明，与短时间验证相比，全文核查大大改进了对无支持答复的检测。我们的经验突出表明，何时需要长文核查，为什么在真实文件中往往不进行块式检查，以及预算如何塑造模型。这些研究结果为从业人员建设可靠的大规模检索强化应用程序提供了实际指导。 (模式、基准和代码：https://huggingface.co/llm-semantic-router)

items.detail: The rapidly growing demand for high-quality data in Large Language Models (LLMs) has intensified the need for scalable, reliable, and semantically rich data preparation pipelines. However, current practices remain dominated by ad-hoc scripts and loosely specified workflows, which lack principled abstractions, hinder reproducibility, and offer limited support for model-in-the-loop data generation. To address these challenges, we present DataFlow, a unified and extensible LLM-driven data preparation framework. DataFlow is designed with system-level abstractions that enable modular, reusable, and composable data transformations, and provides a PyTorch-style pipeline construction API for building debuggable and optimizable dataflows. The framework consists of nearly 200 reusable operators and six domain-general pipelines spanning text, mathematical reasoning, code, Text-to-SQL, agentic RAG, and large-scale knowledge extraction. To further improve usability, we introduce DataFlow-Agent, which automatically translates natural-language specifications into executable pipelines via operator synthesis, pipeline planning, and iterative verification. Across six representative use cases, DataFlow consistently improves downstream LLM performance. Our math, code, and text pipelines outperform curated human datasets and specialized synthetic baselines, achieving up to +3\% execution accuracy in Text-to-SQL over SynSQL, +7\% average improvements on code benchmarks, and 1--3 point gains on MATH, GSM8K, and AIME. Moreover, a unified 10K-sample dataset produced by DataFlow enables base models to surpass counterparts trained on 1M Infinity-Instruct data. These results demonstrate that DataFlow provides a practical and high-performance substrate for reliable, reproducible, and scalable LLM data preparation, and establishes a system-level foundation for future data-centric AI development.
items.title_zh: DataFlow：数据科学AI时代统一数据编制和工作流程自动化的LLM-Driven框架
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)对高质量数据的需求迅速增加，因此更加需要可扩展、可靠和精密的数据编制管道。然而，目前的做法仍然以临时的脚本和松散地指定的工作流程为主，这些工作流程缺乏原则性抽象，阻碍可复制性，并且对即时数据模型生成提供了有限的支持。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了“数据流”，一个统一和可扩展的LLM驱动数据编制框架。 DataFlow采用系统级抽象设计，可实现模块化，可再用和可堆叠的数据转换，并提供PyTorch风格的管道构造 API用于构建可调试和可选择的数据流。该框架包括近200个可重复使用的操作员和6个域通管，跨越文本，数学推理，代码，文本到SQL，代理RAG，以及大规模的知识提取。为了进一步提高可用性，我们引入了"DataFlow-Agent"(DataFlow-Agent)，通过运营商合成，管道规划和迭代验证，自动将自然语言规格翻译为可执行管线。在六个有代表性的使用案例中，DataFlow持续改善下游的LLM性能。我们的数学、代码和文本管道比人类数据集和专门的合成基线要好，在文本到SQL的执行精度高于SynSQL， +7+在代码基准上的平均改进，以及MATH、GSM8K和AIME上的1-3分增益。此外，由DataFlow制作的统一10K-抽样数据集使基础模型能够超越接受过1M无穷指令数据培训的对应数据。这些结果表明，"DataFlow"为可靠，可再生，可扩展的LLM数据编制提供了实用而高性能的底板，为未来以数据为中心的AI开发奠定了系统层面的基础。

items.detail: Computer use agents automate digital tasks by directly interacting with graphical user interfaces (GUIs) on computers and mobile devices, offering significant potential to enhance human productivity by completing an open-ended space of user queries. However, current agents face significant challenges: imprecise grounding of GUI elements, difficulties with long-horizon task planning, and performance bottlenecks from relying on single generalist models for diverse cognitive tasks. To this end, we introduce Agent S2, a novel compositional framework that delegates cognitive responsibilities across various generalist and specialist models. We propose a novel Mixture-of-Grounding technique to achieve precise GUI localization and introduce Proactive Hierarchical Planning, dynamically refining action plans at multiple temporal scales in response to evolving observations. Evaluations demonstrate that Agent S2 establishes new state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on three prominent computer use benchmarks. Specifically, Agent S2 achieves 18.9% and 32.7% relative improvements over leading baseline agents such as Claude Computer Use and UI-TARS on the OSWorld 15-step and 50-step evaluation. Moreover, Agent S2 generalizes effectively to other operating systems and applications, surpassing previous best methods by 52.8% on WindowsAgentArena and by 16.52% on AndroidWorld relatively. Code available at https://github.com/simular-ai/Agent-S.
items.title_zh: S2：计算机使用代理人的构成通用-专门框架
items.detail_zh: 计算机使用代理人通过直接与计算机和移动设备上的图形用户界面(GUIs)互动，实现数字任务的自动化，通过完成一个开放的用户查询空间，为提高人的生产力提供了巨大潜力。然而，目前的代理人面临重大挑战：图形用户界面要素的基础不准确，长期任务规划有困难，以及不同认知任务依赖单一的通论模式所产生的性能瓶颈。为此，我们引入了S2特工(Agent S2)，这是一种全新的组成框架，将认知责任分散到各种通论模式和专家模式。我们提出一种新型的 " 组合 " 技术，以实现精确的图形用户界面本地化，并采用积极主动的分级规划，根据不断发展的观测结果，在多时范围内动态地完善行动计划。评估表明，S2代理公司在三个著名的计算机使用基准上建立了新的先进(SOTA)性能。具体来说，S2代理公司在OSWorld 15步和50步评价上比克劳德计算机使用和UI-TARS等主要基线代理公司实现18.9%和32.7%的相对改进。此外，Agent S2有效地概括到其他操作系统和应用上，在Windows AgentArena上比以往最佳方法高出52.8%，在AndroidWorld上比16.52%。代码见https://github.com/simular-ai/Agent-S。
