items.detail: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated whole-body interaction with the physical world, yet collecting robot demonstrations at scale remains costly. Human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but existing egocentric human supervision often omits locomotion and posture, while embodiment differences and controller dynamics hinder accurate end-effector execution. We introduce HumanVerse, a 500-hour dataset of open-world human loco-manipulation pairing egocentric video with synchronized body and hand motion. Our human-to-humanoid pipeline aligns camera viewpoints and arm appearance, and refines motion references and controller inputs offline to reduce end-effector errors while preserving whole-body coordination. We validate the pipeline through zero-shot transfer to Unitree G1 on representative whole-body manipulation and long-range loco-manipulation tasks, without target-task robot demonstrations. Building on this pipeline, we develop λ_0, a humanoid foundation model for whole-body loco-manipulation, with robot-aligned human demonstrations providing supervision for mid-training. Increasing whole-body human data consistently improves downstream task progress. λ_0 achieves 90.0% success on SIMPLE and 62.5% across real-world loco-manipulation tasks. We expect this study to guide scalable whole-body human data collection toward humanoid foundation models for richer interaction with the physical world. Homepage: https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/
items.title_zh: λ 0：扩大开放-世界爱高中心人类数据用于人造Loco-Manipulation
items.detail_zh: 人机操纵需要与物理世界协调的全身互动，但大规模收集机器人演示仍然费用高昂。人类示威提供了可扩展的替代方案，但现有的以自我为中心的人类监督往往省略了运动和姿态，而表现差异和控制动态则阻碍准确的终极效果执行。我们介绍HumanVerse，一个500小时的数据集 开阔的世界Human loco-manapulation配对 自我中心视频 同步的身体和手动。我们的人对人输油管将相机视线和手臂外观对准，并改进离线的运动参考和控制器输入，以减少终端效应误差，同时保持全身协调。我们通过零射转至Unitree G1验证输油管，执行具有代表性的全体操控和远程机组操控任务，不进行目标任务机器人演示。在这个管道的基础上，我们开发了XQ0，一个人造人基础模型，用于全身的loco操纵，机器人与人相配合的演示为中训提供监督。增加整体人类数据不断改善下游任务的进展。 λ 0在SIMPLE上取得了90.0%的成功，在现实世界的loco操纵任务上取得了62.5%的成功。我们期望这一研究引导可伸缩的全体人类数据收集向人文基础模型，以便与物理世界进行更丰富的互动。主页：https://lambdahumanoid.github.io/ 互联网档案馆的存檔，存档日期2013-12-21。

items.detail: Frontier open-weight models are increasingly available, but serving them still largely assumes datacenter infrastructure. We present FreeToken, an edge-native MoE serving system that treats a personal machine not as a small GPU, but as a unified, elastic inference platform. FreeToken co-designs the full serving stack, including model layout and loading, expert residency, CPU--GPU execution, agentic state reuse, and runtime memory management, around two realities of local AI: agent workloads continuously change their execution pattern, and edge hardware exposes heterogeneous resources whose balance differs from machine to machine. Rather than committing to a fixed offloading strategy, FreeToken continuously maps computation and model state onto the resources actually available. FreeToken supports more than 20 MoE models and real coding and tool-using agents across hardware ranging from an 8GB laptop GPU to a single workstation GPU. More importantly, it changes what these machines can practically serve, from a 35B model on a laptop to a 284B model on a gaming desktop and the 753B GLM-5.2 on a single workstation GPU. FreeToken turns open weights into deployable local software, making the machines users already own a practical platform for frontier-scale intelligence. We release the system at flashml.ai.
items.title_zh: FreeToken：高效边疆部 与 Bandwidth 辅助执行
items.detail_zh: 边疆开放重量模型越来越多，但为这些模型服务在很大程度上仍假定数据中心基础设施。我们介绍FreeToken，一种边缘内置的MOE服务系统，它不把个人机器当作一个小的GPU，而是作为一个统一的弹性推论平台。 FreeToken共同设计了完整的服务堆栈，包括模型布局和加载，专家居住，CPU-GPU执行，代理状态再利用，以及运行时间内存管理，围绕本地AI的两个现实：代理工作量不断改变其执行模式，边缘硬件暴露出不同的资源，其平衡因机器而异。 FreeToken没有致力于固定的卸载战略，而是不断将计算和模型状态映射到实际可用的资源中。 FreeToken支持超过20个MOE模型以及从8GB笔记本电脑GPU到单一工作站GPU等跨硬件的真实编码和工具使用代理。更重要的是，它改变了这些机器实际上能够服务的东西，从笔记本电脑上的35B型改为游戏桌面上的284B型和单一工作站GPU上的753B GLM-5.2型。 FreeToken将开放的权重转化为可部署的本地软件，使得机器用户已经拥有了一个实用的前沿规模智能平台。我们发布系统 在闪存。

items.detail: Conversational systems, such as duplex speech language models (SLMs), still lack a streaming, accurate, and empathetic memory system as their soul. We introduce VoiceMem, a simple memory architecture with a parallel informational left brain, an emotional right brain, and streaming memory I/O mechanisms. We further build a complete pipeline for memory-aware SLM training, long-horizon evaluation, and decoupled deployment with interchangeable memory backends. Experiments and real-world deployment show three advantages: i) Accuracy: under top-5 retrieval, the left brain outperforms classical systems such as Mem0 at top-200 by nearly 30 points; ii) Emotional & Personal: the right brain, with short- and long-horizon affective attribution and dual-node persona modeling, achieves state-of-the-art performance across three persona benchmarks and improves the aggregate score by 4.29 points over the previous best system; and iii) Real-Time & Cheap: VoiceMem completes retrieval in 134 ms, well within standard VAD latency, adding no extra conversational delay while maintaining high accuracy and low cost. These results show that VoiceMem provides a practical memory foundation for real-time, personalized, and emotionally aware speech interaction.
items.title_zh: VoiceMem：流动双脑内存用于实时互动
items.detail_zh: 对话式系统，如双倍语音语言模型(SLMS)，仍然缺乏作为灵魂的流体，准确性和爱心记忆系统。我们引入了VoiceMem，一个简单的记忆架构，它具有平行的信息左脑，情感右脑，以及流传的记忆I/O机制。我们进一步为记忆意识的可持续土地管理培训、长视野评估以及与可互换记忆后端脱钩的部署搭建了完整的管道。实验和现实世界部署显示三个优点： (一)精准度：在最高-5检索下，左脑在最高-200的Mem0等古典系统上以近30分超越； (二)情感与个人：右脑，具有短和长距离的反感归属和双节点人物模型，在三个人物基准上实现最先进的性能，比之前的最佳系统提高总分4.29分； (三)实时与便宜度：声音Mem完成134ms的检索，远在标准的VAD空位内，在保持高精度和低成本的同时，不增加额外的对话延迟。这些结果表明，VoiceMem为实时，个性化，情感意识的语音互动提供了实用的记忆基础。

items.detail: Computer use has reached a turning point: the focus is expanding from GUI-only interaction to systems that complete tasks on users' computers through visual and programmatic interfaces. We define a generalist computer-use agent (GCUA) as a system in which the model chooses how to observe, act, and organize its work across visual and programmatic interfaces. Yet frontier implementations, such as GPT-6 Astra's computer-use system, remain largely closed, limiting systematic study of their design. We introduce Open Generalist CUA (OpenGCUA), an ongoing project to develop and open the full stack for GCUAs with the community. This report presents the first release of OpenGCUA. Code execution is a key feature of our agent design: it lets intermediate results determine subsequent operations and enables models to apply their existing programming capabilities directly to computer interaction. We also propose harness-to-model decision transfer, moving selected observations and task-state decisions from fixed harness rules to the model. On OSWorld-v2, our full configuration improves task scores across all eight evaluated models, including GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5, raising mean partial score by +19.6 points and reducing reported steps per task by an average of 53.0% relative to batched GUI-only execution. We release our implementation and prompts, evaluation trajectories from all eight models, and preliminary versions of a real-device harness and a cross-device SDK. The harness addresses real-device challenges not fully captured by benchmarks, while the SDK provides a common programming interface across computers, mobiles and browsers. Across four real macOS tasks under our real-device harness, selected Qwen3.8-Max runs use 19.4 times as many reported reasoning tokens as GPT-6 Astra, highlighting substantial differences between models in real-device execution efficiency.
items.title_zh: OpenGCUA：走向一个通用计算机的全张开放堆栈
items.detail_zh: 计算机的使用已经到了一个转折点：焦点正在从只使用图形界面的交互扩展到通过视觉和程序接口完成用户计算机任务的系统。我们把通用计算机使用代理(GCUA)定义为一个系统，在该系统中，模型选择如何观察，采取行动，并组织其跨越视觉和节目界面的工作。然而，前沿实施，例如GPT-6 Astra的计算机使用系统，基本上仍然关闭，限制了对其设计的系统研究。我们提出开放通用的CUA(OpenGCUA)，这是一个持续进行的项目，旨在开发并开放面向社区的全球CUA的完整堆栈。本报告介绍OpenGCUA的首次发行。代码执行是我们代理设计的一个关键特征：它让中间结果决定后续的操作，并使模型能够将其现有的编程能力直接应用于计算机交互。我们还提议从固定规则到模式的决策转移，将选定的观察和任务状态的决定从固定规则转移到模式。在OSWorld-v2上，我们的全面配置提高了包括GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5在内的所有8个评价模型的任务分数，将平均部分分数提高+19.6分，并将每个任务的报告步骤比批量的GUI只执行平均减少53.0%。我们发布了我们的执行和提示，评估轨迹 从所有8个模型，和初步版本的 真实的装置和交叉的装置SDK。该套接字处理的是基准没有完全捕捉到的真设备挑战，而SDK则提供了一个跨计算机，移动和浏览器的共同编程接口。通过我们真设备的4个真正的macOS任务，被选中的Quen3.8-Max运行时使用的推理符是GPT-6 Astra的19.4倍，凸显了真设备执行效率模型之间的巨大差异。

items.detail: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.
items.title_zh: 代理缓存工程
items.detail_zh: 大语言模型(LLM)代理能够处理越来越复杂的任务，导航观测和行动的长期轨迹。随着这些轨迹的增长，密钥值(KV)缓存I/O和存储成为主导成本。轨迹也可以超过LLM的最大上下文长度，需要控制主动缓存生长。先前的工作使用上下文工程来通过裁剪或总结历史来减少缓存大小。然而，修改轨迹前缀会使随后的缓存状态失效，并引发对保留上下文进行成本高昂的重置。如果保留的内容太少，无法限制重新准备费用，任务准确性也会受到影响。我们提出缓存工程是新计划 它允许代理直接控制其活跃的KV缓存，而无需修改轨迹或重新预填保留上下文。具体来说，代理可以主动使用滴滴将选定的缓存排除在将来的注意之外，并重置以调整保留键的位置编码。我们把这些缓存操作正规化，并确定历史依赖性为服务挑战：相同的符号序列可以在不同的缓存操作序列下产生不同的缓存状态，使得前缀匹配不足以正确缓存再利用。因此，我们共同设计AKV服务引擎。它提供了一个与现有的服务API兼容的无国籍界面，同时在内部管理状态缓存再利用，驱逐，和恢复。实验显示，与传统的阈值触发总和相比，工具响应滚动投放缓存政策将平均基准分数提高1.7分，平均成本降低27.7%。与AKV一起，它可以实现高达1.2x的输出吞吐量，并在P95请求潜伏中实现1.5x加速。自动改进缓存政策，使成本比专家设计进一步降低7.1%。我们的代码在https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV上。

items.title: A decoder-only foundation model for time-series forecasting
items.subtitle: Motivated by recent advances in large language models for Natural Language Processing (NLP), we design a time-series foundation model for forecasting whose out-of-the-box zero-shot performance on a variety of public datasets comes close to the accuracy of state-of-the-art supervised forecasting models for each individual dataset. Our model is based on pretraining a patched-decoder style attention model on a large time-series corpus, and can work well across different forecasting history lengths, prediction lengths and temporal granularities.

items.detail: High-resolution video matting requires preserving fine details, such as hair strands and soft transparency, while maintaining consistency across frames. Memory-based methods achieve strong matting quality by matching current-frame features with information stored from earlier frames, but this process becomes increasingly costly as resolution grows. We present MatAnyone-E, an efficient extension of MatAnyone 2 that focuses computation where it is most needed. Our approach first performs low-resolution propagation to identify uncertain regions that require closer inspection and the memory candidates most relevant to them. It then performs high-resolution matching only for these regions using the selected memory, while reusing low-resolution matching results elsewhere. This strategy reduces both the number of locations requiring detailed matching and the amount of memory searched, while preserving the information needed to produce a complete matte. We further reduce the cost of generating high-resolution mattes with a lightweight decoder designed around measured runtime bottlenecks and trained to reproduce the original decoder's representations. Experiments show that MatAnyone-E maintains matting quality comparable to MatAnyone 2 while achieving an estimated 7.4x inference speedup and reducing peak GPU memory usage to 7.6% of the usage of MatAnyone 2 at 4K. With compilation-enabled inference on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU, it reaches 73.07 FPS at 1080p and 28.62 FPS at 4K.
items.title_zh: MatAnyone-E：高效高分辨率视频编审的 sparse 内存宣传
items.detail_zh: 高分辨的视频交配需要保存细细的细节，如发线和软透明，同时保持跨帧的一致性。基于内存的方法通过将当前帧特征与从更早的帧所储存的信息相匹配来达到强烈的搭配质量，但随着分辨率的增加，这一过程变得日益昂贵。我们介绍MatAnyone-E，这是MatAnyone 2的有效扩展，它把计算重点放在最需要的地方。我们的方法首先进行低分辨率的传播，以查明需要更密切检查的不确定区域以及与其最相关的记忆候选人。然后它只使用所选的内存对这些区域进行高分辨率匹配，同时在其他地方使用低分辨率匹配结果。这一策略既能减少需要详细匹配的地点数量，又能减少内存被搜索的数量，同时能保存产生完整mate所需的信息。我们进一步降低产生高分辨率的垫子的成本，并用一个轻量级的解码器来设计围绕所测量的运行时间瓶颈，并经过训练来复制原始解码器的表示。实验显示，MatAnyone-E保持了与MatAnyone 2相仿的交配质量，同时实现了估计的7.4x推论速度并将顶峰GPU内存使用率降低到4K时MatAnyone 2的7.6%。通过对单NVIDIA H200 GPU的编译推论，在1080p时达到73.07FPS，在4K时达到28.62FPS。

items.detail: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.

items.detail: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential as autonomous agents, approaching human-expert performance through advanced reasoning and tool orchestration. However, decision-making in fully dynamic and live environments remains highly challenging, requiring real-time information integration and adaptive responses. While existing efforts have explored live evaluation mechanisms in structured tasks, a critical gap remains in systematic benchmarking for real-world applications, particularly in finance where stringent requirements exist for live strategic responsiveness. To address this gap, we introduce AI-Trader, the first fully-automated, live, and data-uncontaminated evaluation benchmark for LLM agents in financial decision-making. AI-Trader spans three major financial markets: U.S. stocks, A-shares, and cryptocurrencies, with multiple trading granularities to simulate live financial environments. Our benchmark implements a revolutionary fully autonomous minimal information paradigm where agents receive only essential context and must independently search, verify, and synthesize live market information without human intervention. We evaluate six mainstream LLMs across three markets and multiple trading frequencies. Our analysis reveals striking findings: general intelligence does not automatically translate to effective trading capability, with most agents exhibiting poor returns and weak risk management. We demonstrate that risk control capability determines cross-market robustness, and that AI trading strategies achieve excess returns more readily in highly liquid markets than policy-driven environments. These findings expose critical limitations in current autonomous agents and provide clear directions for future improvements. The code and evaluation data are open-sourced to foster community research: https://github.com/HKUDS/AI-Trader.
items.title_zh: AI-Trader：实时金融市场自主代理基准
items.detail_zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)表现出了作为自主代理的显著潜力，通过先进的推理和工具的管弦来接近人类-专家的性能。然而，在充满活力的现场环境中作出决策仍然极具挑战性，需要实时信息整合和适应性反应。虽然现有努力在结构化任务中探索了现场评价机制，但在对现实世界的应用进行系统衡量方面仍然存在重大差距，特别是在资金方面，因为对于现场战略反应能力有严格的要求。为了弥补这一差距，我们采用了AI-Trader，这是财务决策中第一个完全自动化、实时和未受数据污染的LLM剂评价基准。 AI-Trader跨越三大金融市场：美国股票，A股，和密码，有多个交易颗粒以模拟活的金融环境。我们的基准执行一种革命性、完全自主的最低限度信息范式，即代理人只接受基本环境，必须独立搜索、核实和综合市场实况信息，而无需人类干预。我们评估了三个市场和多个交易频率的六个主流有限责任公司。我们的分析揭示了惊人的结论：一般情报不会自动转化为有效的贸易能力，大多数代理人的回报不佳，风险管理薄弱。我们表明，风险控制能力决定了跨市场的稳健性，AI贸易战略比政策驱动的环境更容易在高流动性市场实现超额回报。这些调查结果暴露了目前自主代理机构的关键局限性，为今后的改进提供了明确的方向。代码和评价数据开源，以促进社区研究：https://github.com/HKUDS/AI-Trader。

items.detail: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, Ψ_0, ω-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.
items.title_zh: Ropedia W0：利用人类经验在安徽推广Loco-Manipulation世界模式
items.detail_zh: 世界模式使体现的代理人能够预见到行动的后果，但是，由于行动空间各异和多式联运监督有限，在各种表现形式上联合模拟运动和操纵仍然具有挑战性。我们介绍Ropedia W0，这是第一个以自我为中心 游戏操控世界的基础模型，覆盖了人类和机器人，并有着不同的化身。我们管理Xp-Data，包括10k小时的自我中心人类数据和3k小时的机器人数据，并附有统一的多式联运说明和系统的质量控制。统一的动能表现编码通过相机摆设和操纵通过投影骨架进行运动，机器人骨架将浮雕特异性前动能与广泛的手动键点注释和校正相结合。我们还采用了Xp-Teleop，这是一个基于高质量脱氧核糖核酸人电动操作数据的长视离子操纵基准。评估显示，在五个交叉表现基准(DreamDojo、XΨ 0、Xω-HOME、Xp-Teleop和AgiBot)中，以及在从零镜头推论到数镜头和完整数据培训后视频上，表现最先进的表现。扩大人类培训前数据可提高人类和机器人评价的性能。蒸馏后，我们的模型支持实时，一分钟的推出，使VR能够进行现场互动。政策评估、基于模型的规划和世界行动模型方面的应用进一步表明该模型对体现的决策的有用性。

items.title: Agent^2 RL-Bench: Can LLM Agents Engineer Agentic RL Post-Training?
items.subtitle: We introduce Agent2 RL-Bench, a compact diagnostic benchmark for evaluating agentic RL post-training, which tests whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, debug, and execute post-training pipelines that improve foundation models. RL post-training increasingly drives model alignment and specialization, yet existing benchmarks are largely static, rewarding supervised fine-tuning or script generation without assessing an agent's ability to close an interactive RL loop. items.detail: We introduce Agent2 RL-Bench, a compact diagnostic benchmark for evaluating agentic RL post-training, which tests whether LLM agents can autonomously design, implement, debug, and execute post-training pipelines that improve foundation models. RL post-training increasingly drives model alignment and specialization, yet existing benchmarks are largely static, rewarding supervised fine-tuning or script generation without assessing an agent's ability to close an interactive RL loop. Agent2 RL-Bench provides a unified agent-facing interface: each run starts from an isolated workspace containing a base model, task data, instructions, and a grading API, and agents must iterate within a fixed budget by training models and submitting artifacts for evaluation. The benchmark spans six tasks across three levels, from static rule-based training to judge-based optimization and closed-loop online RL with trajectory collection. Two diagnostic skills, namely runtime recording and post-hoc summarization, enable structured analysis of agent behavior, facilitating smooth and effective iteration of the benchmark's evaluation framework. Across five agent systems and six driver LLMs, agents show intelligent behavior but clear limitations: one RL-oriented run improves ALFWorld from 4.85 to 93.28 via SFT warm-up and GRPO with online rollouts, yet DeepSearchQA remains difficult, most successful routes rely on supervised pipelines, and interactive outcomes show large single-run differences across agent stacks. Overall, Agent2 RL-Bench shows that current agents can sometimes engineer online RL, but stable agent-driven RL post-training remains rare under fixed budgets. It also demonstrates that our benchmark provides a strong and effective evaluation framework for future research in this direction. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl_bench/README.md
items.title_zh: 代理 ^2 RL- Bench： LLM 代理 工程师 代理 RL 后训练？
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了Agent2 RL-Bench，这是评价代理RL后训练的紧凑诊断基准，该基准测试LLM代理是否能够自主地设计，执行，调试，以及执行改进基础模型的训练后管线。 RL后培训越来越能推动模型的对接和专业化，但现有的基准基本是静态的，奖励有监督的微调或脚本生成，而不评估代理商关闭交互式RL环的能力。 Agent2 RL-Bench提供了统一的代理-造型接口：每次运行都从一个孤立的工作空间开始，包含一个基础模型，任务数据，指令，以及一个分级的API，代理必须通过培训模型和提交文物进行评价，在固定预算范围内进行迭接。该基准跨越从静态规则培训到基于法官的优化和有轨迹收集的闭路在线RL等三个层面的6个任务。两种诊断技能，即运行时间记录和随机汇总后，能够对代理行为进行有条理的分析，促进基准评价框架的平稳和有效迭代。在五个代理系统和六个驱动程序LLMs中，代理显示智能行为，但有明显的局限性：一个面向RL的运行改进了ALFWorld，从4.85到93.28通过SFT热身和GPRO在线推出，然而DeepSearchQA仍然困难重重，大多数成功路线依赖于有监督的管线，互动结果显示各代理堆的单运行差异很大。总体而言，Agent2 RL-Bench显示，当前代理有时可以在线设计RL，但稳定代理驱动的RL后培训在固定预算下仍然罕见。它还表明，我们的基准为今后这方面的研究提供了有力而有效的评价框架。代码见https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent/blob/main/rdagent/scenarios/rl/autorl bench/README.md。

items.title: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
items.subtitle: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. items.detail: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.
items.title_zh: GPT-6-Astra是否实现了健全的情报工作？
items.detail_zh: GPT-6-Astra在机器人操纵和导航方面表现出一定的能力，对为个别任务和表现建立专门模型的传统模式提出了挑战。在本报告中，我们不仅询问GPT-6-Astra的能力如何，而且询问它在这方面的能力意味着什么。首先，我们探索独立的GPT-6-Astra的极限。我们对12个代表性基准进行大规模评估，这些基准包括桌面操纵、人造物、移动平台和狡猾的手。根据统一协议，允许从培训设置的演示中学习内容，并大大增加执行步骤的数量，GPT-6-Astra取得了前所未有的业绩(图1)。未来的研究可能侧重于改善1)ICL的通用性2)成本和执行时间，3)物理状态核查，4)从不可逆转的故障中恢复，5)长期保存进度。其次，我们研究了 内含的控制手段 我们确认，一个高级的"System 2"(即GPT-6-Astra)和低级的"System 1"控制器(如π0.5)之间的近距离协调成本高昂，但很有效。第三，我们审查GPT-6-Astra在现实世界的部署。我们关于8个机器人配置的实验揭示了巨大的缺口：1)ICL所需的机器人演示费很昂贵的收集，2)以较长的执行时间换取更高的成功率与物理限制是难以置信的。第四，我们设想下一代包含的基准。我们开发了一个原型，即：(1) 任务来自现实世界的需要；(2) 不提供领域内示范；(3) 法官在不断运转的世界时钟上进行审议。总而言之，我们的结果表明，GPT-6-Astra在很大程度上已经超越了体现的能力的门槛，但尚未超越实际体现的智力的门槛。

items.detail: Data-centric training has emerged as a promising direction for improving large language models (LLMs) by optimizing not only model parameters but also the selection, composition, and weighting of training data during optimization. However, existing approaches to data selection, data mixture optimization, and data reweighting are often developed in isolated codebases with inconsistent interfaces, hindering reproducibility, fair comparison, and practical integration. In this paper, we present DataFlex, a unified data-centric dynamic training framework built upon LLaMA-Factory. DataFlex supports three major paradigms of dynamic data optimization: sample selection, domain mixture adjustment, and sample reweighting, while remaining fully compatible with the original training workflow. It provides extensible trainer abstractions and modular components, enabling a drop-in replacement for standard LLM training, and unifies key model-dependent operations such as embedding extraction, inference, and gradient computation, with support for large-scale settings including DeepSpeed ZeRO-3. We conduct comprehensive experiments across multiple data-centric methods. Dynamic data selection consistently outperforms static full-data training on MMLU across both Mistral-7B and Llama-3.2-3B. For data mixture, DoReMi and ODM improve both MMLU accuracy and corpus-level perplexity over default proportions when pretraining Qwen2.5-1.5B on SlimPajama at 6B and 30B token scales. DataFlex also achieves consistent runtime improvements over original implementations. These results demonstrate that DataFlex provides an effective, efficient, and reproducible infrastructure for data-centric dynamic training of LLMs.
items.title_zh: DataFlex：大语言模型数据-儿童动态培训的统一框架
items.detail_zh: 以数据为中心的培训已成为改进大型语言模型的有希望的方向，不仅优化了模型参数，而且优化了培训数据的选择、组成和权重。然而，数据选择、数据混合物优化和数据重新加权的现有方法常常是在接口不一致的孤立代码库中开发的，阻碍了可复制性、公平比较和实际的整合。在本文中，我们介绍了DataFlex，这是一个基于LLaMA-Factory的统一的数据中心动态培训框架。 DataFlex支持动态数据优化的三个主要范式：样本选择，域混合调整，以及样本重置，同时保持与原始培训工作流程完全兼容。它提供了可扩展的教练抽象和模块化组件，使得标准LLM培训能够进行即时替换，并统一了嵌入提取，推论，梯度计算等依赖模型的关键操作，支持包括DeepSpeed ZeRO-3在内的大规模设置。我们通过多种以数据为中心的方法进行全面实验。动态数据选择在Mistral-7B和Llama-3.2-3B两地的MMLU静态全数据培训上，始终比其业绩要好。对于数据混合物，当在SlimPajama上预训Quen2.5-1.5B时，DoRemi和ODM在6B和30B符号尺度上提高MMLU的精度和实体级的复杂度，而不是默认比例。 DataFlex还实现了与原始执行相比的连续运行时间改进。这些结果表明，DataFlex为LLMs的数据中心动态培训提供了一个有效、高效和可复制的基础设施。

items.detail: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has demonstrated remarkable success in enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) through external knowledge integration, yet its application has primarily focused on textual content, leaving the rich domain of multi-modal video knowledge predominantly unexplored. This paper introduces VideoRAG, the first retrieval-augmented generation framework specifically designed for processing and understanding extremely long-context videos. Our core innovation lies in its dual-channel architecture that seamlessly integrates (i) graph-based textual knowledge grounding for capturing cross-video semantic relationships, and (ii) multi-modal context encoding for efficiently preserving visual features. This novel design empowers VideoRAG to process unlimited-length videos by constructing precise knowledge graphs that span multiple videos while maintaining semantic dependencies through specialized multi-modal retrieval paradigms. Through comprehensive empirical evaluation on our proposed LongerVideos benchmark-comprising over 160 videos totaling 134+ hours across lecture, documentary, and entertainment categories-VideoRAG demonstrates substantial performance compared to existing RAG alternatives and long video understanding methods. The source code of VideoRAG implementation and the benchmark dataset are openly available at: https://github.com/HKUDS/VideoRAG.
items.title_zh: VideoRAG：带有极端长文视频的检索-强化生成
items.detail_zh: 检索增强型生成(RAG)在通过外部知识集成增强大语言模型(LLMS)方面取得了显著成功，然而其应用主要侧重于文字内容，使得多模式视频知识的丰富领域大多未探索。本文介绍VideoRAG，这是第一个专门为处理和理解极长文本视频而设计的检索增强生成框架。我们的核心创新在于其双渠道结构，它无缝地融合了(一) 以图表为基础的文字知识，以获取跨视频语义关系；(二) 有效保存视觉特征的多式联运上下文编码。这种小说设计赋予VideoRAG处理无限长度视频的能力，方法是构建精准的知识图，跨越多个视频，同时通过专门的多模式检索范式保持语义依赖性。由超过160个视频组成，总共134小时，包括讲座、纪录片和娱乐类， VideoRAG执行的源代码和基准数据集可在https://github.com/HKUDS/VideoRAG上公开查阅。

items.subtitle: Precise grounding matters. items.detail: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI's pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding's substantial benefits for both, and OCR's potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.
items.title_zh: 地面基础：面向视觉原始体的地面基础模型
items.detail_zh: 精密地基事项。它指定了哪个物体是目标，以及该物体的位置，即使是在杂乱无章的物体中和对于小物体来说，它必须足够快地进行闭路控制。然而，视觉-语言行动(VLA)和世界行动模式(WAMS)从通用视觉-语言和视频生成的骨干中吸取了感知力，而这些在这样的环境下仍然失败。我们引入了GroundingPI，一种4B的Grounding基础模型，它生成点和框作为共享词汇中的量化坐标。培训将多式联运和空间预训、监督微调、强化学习与GPRO相结合，利用公共数据集和专用数据引擎的监督。根据34个地面基准的44个基线，地面测量项目确定了新的技术水平，平均为73.68%，高于较大的GPT-6 Astra(71.54%)。作为下游视觉骨干，GroundingPI改进了机器人操纵和自主驾驶的性能。在RoboTwin 2.0上，它比我们评价的所有四个分配外环境的所有主流骨干都好，相对于最强的骨干而言，最高达24.8%。在RoboCasa-GR1上，50%的示威活动都超过了75%的培训基线。在作为视觉主干线的nuScenes上，GroundingPI平均实现0.296米的开球L2误差。我们系统地分析地表指数在规模和数据构成方面的预训。随着预训规模的扩大，下游自主驾驶和机器人操纵得到了改进。分析这11种感知能力的数据配方，显示出密集地面对两者的巨大好处，以及OCR作为感知学习的催化剂的潜力。这些结果支持将认知基础作为基础，并专门进行认知前培训，作为身体智能基础模型的有希望的方向。

items.subtitle: KV cache has traditionally been stored in GPU memory to accelerate the decoding phase of large language model (LLM) inference. items.detail: KV cache has traditionally been stored in GPU memory to accelerate the decoding phase of large language model (LLM) inference. However, it is increasingly necessary to move KV caches outside GPU devices, to enable cache reuse across different queries and inference engines. Our real-world usage statistics confirm this trend: over time, the total KV cache stored by users has grown rapidly, far exceeding the capacity of GPU memory. Despite this need, there lacks an efficient solution for offloading and transferring KV caches. We present LMCACHE, the first and so far the most efficient open-source KV caching solution, which extracts and stores KV caches generated by modern LLM engines (vLLM and SGLang) out of the GPU memory and shares them across engines and queries. LMCACHE supports both cache offloading (prefix reuse across queries) and prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation (cross-engine/GPU cache transfer). LMCACHE's high performance and wide adoption stem from the following contributions: (1) highly optimized KV cache data movement powered by batched data movement operations, compute and I/O pipelining; (2) a modular KV cache connector component, decoupling LMCACHE from the rapid evolution of inference engines; (3) a first-class control API for flexible cache orchestration across GPU, CPU, storage, and network layers. Our evaluation shows that combining LMCACHE with vLLM achieves up to 15x improvement in throughput across workloads such as multi-round question answering and document analysis. Large-scale adoption of LMCACHE in enterprise settings provides us valuable insights, for example, fetching KV cache from remote storage has unsurprisingly benefits to prefill delay, and that context truncation, which is a widely applied technique in industry, can greatly reduce prefix cache hit ratio by half. The source code of LMCACHE is at: https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache.
items.title_zh: LMCach：企业规模 LLM 的高效 KV 缓存层 推论
items.detail_zh: KV缓存传统上被存储在GPU内存中以加速大语言模型(LLM)推论的解码相。然而，越来越有必要将 KV 缓存移出 GPU 设备之外，以便缓存在不同的查询和推论引擎之间重复使用。我们的现实世界使用统计证实了这一趋势：随着时间的推移，用户存储的KV缓存总量迅速增长，远远超过了GPU内存的能力。尽管有这种需要，但对于卸载和转移KV缓存缺乏有效的解决方案。我们提出LMCACHE，这是第一个也是迄今为止效率最高的开源KV缓存解决方案，它从GPU内存中取出并存储由现代LLM引擎(vLLM和SGLang)所生成的KV缓存并共享到引擎和查询中。 LMCACHE既支持缓存卸载(前缀再使用跨查询)，又支持预填解码(PD)分解(cross-engine/GPU缓存传输)。 LMCACHE的高性能和广泛的被采纳来源于以下贡献：(1)通过分批数据移动操作，计算和I/O管线来提供高度优化的KV缓存数据移动；(2)一个模块化的KV缓存连接器组件，将LMCACHE与推论引擎的快速演化脱钩；(3)一个一等控制API，用于跨GPU，CPU，存储，和网络层的灵活缓存管。我们的评价表明，将LMCACHE与vLLM相结合，在多轮回答问题和文件分析等工作量方面，可实现最高达15倍的吞吐量改进。在企业环境中大规模采用LMCACHE，为我们提供了宝贵的见解，例如从远程存储取取出KV缓存对预填延迟毫无意外的好处，而这种上下文截取是工业中广泛应用的一种技术，可以将前缀缓存的命中率大幅降低一半。 LMCACHE的源代码见：https://github.com/LMCache/LMCache。

items.detail: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selectively use video predictions for reasoning about unobserved states and interaction outcomes. We also develop a world-action extension of the full RynnUnify model, translating its understanding and prediction capabilities into robot control. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Rynn-VP and Rynn-GEU for long-horizon visual planning and anticipatory reasoning. Experiments show that RynnUnify achieves the highest average embodied understanding score among the evaluated unified multimodal models and improves the Rynn-VP overall score by 9.75 points over Cosmos 3 Nano. Its agentic extension improves the Rynn-GEU average by 6.0 points over direct reasoning, while the world-action extension achieves 51.5\% success on 20 selected composite RoboCasa365 tasks and 46.7\% average success across three real-robot tasks. Together, these results establish RynnUnify as a shared foundation for embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control, taking a step toward a unified embodied brain.
items.title_zh: Rynn Unification：迈向统一的健全大脑
items.detail_zh: 我们引入了"Rynn Unify"(Rynn Unify)，一个16B的被统一体现的模型，通过相互间视频语言推理，将强烈的被体现的理解与长视距视觉规划相结合。有了跨越空间推理、物理预测和地面的能力，Rynn Unify将对物理世界的理解与对它如何跨越相继的子任务的视觉预期联系起来。在这些能力的基础上，我们通过强化学习，进一步开发一种促进性扩展，有选择地利用视频预测来推理未观察状态和互动结果。我们还开发了全Rynn Unify模型的世界行动扩展，将其理解和预测能力转化为机器人控制。为了评价这些能力，我们引入了Rynn-VP和Rynn-GEU，用于长视距视觉规划和预测推理。实验显示，Rynn Unify在被评价的统一多式模型中实现了最高平均体现的理解分数，并比Cosmos 3 Nano提高了Rynn-VP的整体分数9.75分。其代理扩展比直接推理提高了Rynn-GEU的平均值6.0分，而世界动作扩展则在20项选定的复合机器人Casa365任务上取得了51.5QQ的成功，在3项真机器人任务上取得了46.7QQ的平均成功。这些结果共同建立了Rynn Unification作为体现理解、视觉规划和机器人控制的共同基础，朝着统一的体现大脑迈出了一步。

items.detail: Recent advances have enabled unified omni-modal models in understanding audio, vision, and language. However, existing benchmarks, training data, and learning methods largely treat the modalities independently, leaving the capability of audio-visual joint reasoning poorly evaluated and insufficiently elicited. We address this gap with a benchmark, data engine, and learning method. First, we introduce OmniReasoningBench, a benchmark where both audio and visual evidence are indispensable. It comprises 1,150 multiple-choice and open-ended questions across two tasks, reasoning over video and reasoning beyond video. Second, we develop a data engine OmniQA. It automatically constructs evidence-grounded QA pairs that explicitly necessitate audio-visual joint reasoning, together with time-stamped clue chains that guide the annotation of thinking process. Besides our benchmark, this engine produces training data OmniReasoning-SFT-112K and OmniReasoning-RL-19K. Finally, we propose an on-policy self-distillation method Modality-Factored Self-Distillation (MFSD). It evaluates each sampled response under modality-specific clue contexts, disentangling the contributions of individual clues and their cross-modal interactions for token-level credit assignment. With our training data and learning method, our model OmniReasoning-30B-A3B achieves 50.0% on OmniVideoBench and 42.5% on OmniReasoningBench, improving the base model Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking by 12.8 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Moreover, it delivers substantial gains on general and long-video benchmarks, including Video-MME-v2. We hope our work offers a solid step for facilitating future research in omni-modal joint reasoning.
items.title_zh: OmniReasoning：推进视听联合理性的极限
items.detail_zh: 最近的进展使得在理解音频、视觉和语言方面能够采用统一的全方位模式。然而，现有的基准、培训数据和学习方法基本上独立地对待这些模式，使得视听联合推理的能力没有得到很好的评价并没有得到充分的启发。我们用基准、数据引擎和学习方法来解决这一差距。首先，我们介绍OmniReasoning Bench，这是视听证据都不可或缺的基准。它包括1 150个多重选择和开放式问题，涉及两项任务，即视频推理和视频以外推理。其次，我们开发了一个数据引擎OmniQA。它会自动地构建有证据依据的QA对，明确需要视听联合推理，同时会构建有时间标注的线索链来指导思维过程的注释。除了我们的基准，这个引擎还生成了训练数据OmniReasoning-SFT-112K和OmniReasoning-RL-19K。最后，我们提出一种政策上的自我消化方法，即“自消”方法。它根据特定模式的线索背景评价每个抽样答复，揭示个别线索的贡献以及它们用于象征性信用分配的跨模式互动。通过我们的训练数据和学习方法，我们的OmniReasoning-30B-A3B模型在OmniVideo Bench上达到50.0%，在OmniReasoning Bench上达到42.5%，使基模型Qune3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinking分别提高了12.8%和9.3个百分点。此外，它在一般和长视频基准，包括Video-MME-v2方面，也取得了显著进展。我们希望，我们的工作为便利今后研究全方位联合推理提供了一个坚实的步骤。

items.title: cloudflare/security-audit-skill
items.subtitle: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
items.detail: A coding-agent skill that turns your agent into a security auditor. It orchestrates isolated agents through reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting. This is the skill that seeded Cloudflare's vulnerability discovery harness, described in Build your own vulnerability harness. The harness grew into a multi-stage, fleet-wide system; this skill is the single-repo starting point it evolved from. 1. Reconnaissance -- map architecture, trust boundaries, input surfaces, prior evidence, and deterministic coverage in architecture.md and coverage-ledger.json. 2. Coverage-led hunting -- assign isolated hunters from ledger units, record their checks, and use coverage critics to find gaps. 3. Candidate validation -- give every unique candidate to a fresh verifier that tries to disprove it. 4. Structured output -- write confirmed, needsvalidation, and rejected records to findings.json and validate them against report-schema.json. 5. Independent record verification -- fresh agents verify final source claims. Material replacements receive another independent verifier. 6. Target-neutral reporting -- derive REPORT.md, FINDINGS-DETAIL.md, and NEEDS-VALIDATION.md from the verified records and coverage ledger.
items.subtitle_zh: 分阶段执行安全审计的 Coding Agent Skill：通过架构侦察、覆盖率驱动的缺陷搜索、独立验证和机器可读的发现记录，提高安全审计的可追溯性。
items.detail_zh: 将你的经纪人变成安全审计师的编码技术 它通过侦察、以覆盖为主导的狩猎、候选人验证、结构化产出、独立记录核查以及目标中立的报告，协调孤立的特工。这是Cloudflare的弱点发现工具的种子，在Build自己的弱点工具中描述。牵引力发展成一个多阶段，全舰队范围的系统；这种技能是它从中演化出来的单回波起点。 1。侦察 -- -- 地图结构、信任边界、输入面、先前证据以及架构。md和覆盖-引导器。json的确定性覆盖。 2。覆盖为主的狩猎 -- -- 从分类单元中指派孤立的猎人，记录他们的支票，利用覆盖批评者寻找漏洞。 3。候选人验证 -- -- 将每个独特的候选人交给一个新的核查者，以试图反驳。 4。结构化产出 -- -- 书面确认、需要验证和拒绝对调查结果的记录。 5。独立记录核实 -- -- 新鲜剂核实最终来源声称。物料取代器得到另一个独立的验证器。 6。目标中立的报告 -- -- 从经核实的记录和覆盖分类账中得出报告(m)，FindingS-DETAIL.m和NeedS-Validation.m。

items.title: AgriciDaniel/claude-seo
items.subtitle: Universal SEO skill for Claude Code. 26 sub-skills + 19 sub-agents covering technical SEO, E-E-A-T, schema, GEO/AEO, agent readiness (Lighthouse Agentic Browsing, WebMCP, llms.txt), backlinks, local SEO, e-commerce, international SEO, Google APIs, and PDF/Excel reporting. 9 optional extensions for live SEO data.
items.detail: Free, open-source SEO audits inside Claude Code . Rank higher in Google and get cited by AI search. Claude SEO is a free SEO plugin for Claude Code. Give it any website and it runs a full SEO audit in 10 to 15 minutes, then hands you a clear action plan, sorted by what matters most. Claude SEO is built from 26 sub-skills and 19 specialist agents, and up to 17 agents work on your site at the same time. Every recommendation explains why it matters and how you will know it worked.
items.detail_zh: Claude代码内部的免费开放源代码审计。在Google中排名较高，被AI搜索引用。 Claude SEO是Claude Code的免费SEO插件。给它任何网站，它在10到15分钟内进行一个全面的SEO审计，然后交给你一个明确的行动计划，按最重要的是什么排序。 Claude SEO由26名副技术员和19名特勤员组成 最多17名特勤员同时在你们现场工作 每一个建议都解释了它为什么重要，你如何知道它的作用。

items.title: pbakaus/impeccable
items.subtitle: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
items.detail: Design guidance for AI coding agents. 1 skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration, and 62 deterministic detector rules for AI-generated frontend design. Anthropic's frontend-design was the first widely-used design skill for Claude. Impeccable started from there. Every model trained on the same SaaS templates. Skip the guidance and you get the same handful of tells on every project: Inter for everything, purple-to-blue gradients, cards nested in cards, gray text on colored backgrounds, the rounded-square icon tile above every heading.
items.subtitle_zh: 您编码代理的设计词汇表。更大胆地指导，以批评和审计来审查，在AI的船前抓住斜坡。
items.detail_zh: AI编码代理的设计指导。 1个技能，24个命令，直播浏览器迭代，以及62个确定性探测器规则用于AI生成的前端设计。 Anthropic的前端设计是克劳德第一个广泛使用的设计技能。从那里开始就很完美 每个模型都在同一SaaS模板上训练。跳过引导，然后在每个项目上得到相同的小分数： Inter for everything，紫色到蓝色的梯度，嵌入在卡片中的卡片，灰色的文字在彩色的背景上，圆形平方图标的砖块在每个标题上方。

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.subtitle: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.detail: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for your coding agents, built on top of a set of composable skills and some initial instructions that make sure your agent uses them. It starts from the moment you fire up your coding agent. As soon as it sees that you're building something, it doesn't just jump into trying to write code. Instead, it steps back and asks you what you're really trying to do. Once it's teased a spec out of the conversation, it shows it to you in chunks short enough to actually read and digest.
items.subtitle_zh: 一种有效的代理技能框架和软件开发方法。
items.detail_zh: 超能力(Superpowers)是您编码代理的一种完整的软件开发方法，它建立在一组可堆叠的技能和一些初始指令之上，以确保您的代理使用它们。从你点燃你的编码代理开始 一旦它发现你正在建造某种东西，它就不只是跳跃到试图写代码。相反，它退一步 问你，你到底想做什么。一旦它从对话中取笑了一点，它会用足够短的块来显示它，以实际阅读和消化。

items.title: TauricResearch/TradingAgents
items.subtitle: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
items.detail: 🚀 TradingAgents | ⚡ Installation & CLI | 🎬 Demo | 📦 Package Usage | 🤝 Contributing | 📄 Citation TradingAgents is a multi-agent trading framework that mirrors the dynamics of real-world trading firms. By deploying specialized LLM-powered agents: from fundamental analysts, sentiment experts, and technical analysts, to trader, risk management team, the platform collaboratively evaluates market conditions and informs trading decisions. Moreover, these agents engage in dynamic discussions to pinpoint the optimal strategy. The selected analysts work at the same time, each on its own tools, and the research debate starts once all of their reports are in.
items.subtitle_zh: 贸易代理：多种代理 LLM 金融交易框架
items.detail_zh: 贸易代理商是反映现实世界贸易公司动态的多代理交易框架。通过部署专业的LLM驱动剂：从基本分析师、情绪专家和技术分析师到交易员、风险管理团队，该平台协同评估市场条件并通报交易决定。此外，这些代理人还积极讨论，以确定最佳战略。被选中的分析人员同时工作，各自依靠自己的工具，一旦他们的报告全部收齐，研究辩论就会开始。

items.title: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills
items.subtitle: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls.
items.detail: A single CLAUDE.md file to improve Claude Code behavior, derived from Andrej Karpathy's observations on LLM coding pitfalls. LLMs often pick an interpretation silently and run with it. This principle forces explicit reasoning: The test: Would a senior engineer say this is overcomplicated? If yes, simplify.
items.subtitle_zh: 一个单一的CLAUDE.md文件来改进克劳德代码行为，来源于安德烈·卡纳森对LLM编码陷阱的观察。
items.detail_zh: 一个单一的CLAUDE.md文件来改进克洛德代码行为，它来源于安德烈·卡多斯对LLM编码陷阱的观察。 LLMs经常默默地选择一个解释并随它而去。这一原则迫使人们明确推理：测试：高级工程师会说这过于复杂吗？如果有，简化。

items.detail: Taste Skill is an Agent Skill that makes coding agents design websites and app screens instead of assembling the average landing page. It gives the agent an art direction, real pictures and a way to check its own work in a real browser. The photographs are real, found in open archives and credited by the skill (credits). Watch the launch film. The skill runs its scripts with Node 22+ and an installed Chrome, Edge or Chromium. It installs nothing and needs no API keys. Finding pictures needs network access.

items.title: pingdotgg/t3code
items.detail: T3 Code is an "agent harness control surface". It enables control of the agents on your machine with a best-in-class mobile app (iOS, Android), web app and Electron-based desktop app. Works with your subscriptions on Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, and Google Antigravity. If they're set up on your computer, T3 Code can control them. Nothing. We built T3 Code because we wanted the best possible development experience with agents. We were inspired by existing solutions like the Codex desktop app, Conductor, Claude Desktop and Cursor Glass, but none met our bar.
items.detail_zh: T3代码是"特工控制带表面"。它通过一个最上等的移动应用(iOS，Android)，网络应用和以Electron为基础的桌面应用来控制您机器上的代理。与你的订阅 克劳德代码， Codex， Cursor， Grok Building， OpenCode，和谷歌反重力。如果它们被安装在你的电脑上，T3代码可以控制它们。没什么 我们建立了T3代码，因为我们想要最好的开发经验 与代理。我们受到诸如Codex桌面应用程序、导师、克洛德桌面和光电玻璃等现有解决方案的启发，但都没有遇到我们的酒吧。

items.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
items.subtitle: Open source repository of plugins primarily intended for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork
items.detail: Plugins that turn Claude into a specialist for your role, team, and company. Built for Claude Cowork, also compatible with Claude Code. Cowork lets you set the goal and Claude delivers finished, professional work. Plugins let you go further: tell Claude how you like work done, which tools and data to pull from, how to handle critical workflows, and what slash commands to expose — so your team gets better and more consistent outcomes. Each plugin bundles the skills, connectors, slash commands, and sub-agents for a specific job function. Out of the box, they give Claude a strong starting point for helping anyone in that role. The real power comes when you customize them for your company — your tools, your terminology, your processes — so Claude works like it was built for your team.

items.title: anthropics/skills
items.subtitle: Public repository for Agent Skills
items.detail: Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks. Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks. This repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.). Each skill is self-contained in its own folder with a SKILL.md file containing the instructions and metadata that Claude uses. Browse through these skills to get inspiration for your own skills or to understand different patterns and approaches.
items.subtitle_zh: 代理技能公共仓库
items.detail_zh: 技能是克劳德动态地加载以提高专业任务性能的指令，脚本和资源的文件夹。技能教克洛德如何以可重复的方式完成具体的任务，无论是用你的公司的品牌准则创建文件，利用你的组织的具体工作流程分析数据，还是将个人任务自动化。这个寄存器包含了能展示克劳德的技能系统所可能具备的技能。这些技能从创意应用(艺术，音乐，设计)到技术任务(测试网络应用，MCP服务器生成)到企业工作流程(通信，品牌等)。每种技能都自成一体地放入自己的文件夹，其中包含克洛德使用的指令和元数据的一个SKILL.md文件。通过这些技能来浏览以获得对自身技能的启发或理解不同的模式和方法。

items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库

items.detail: Thousands of Google engineers use EGM, an open-source plugin, to draft specs with deep-context agents and stress-test them with zero-context subagents before writing code. Elephant holds your project context and drafts the specification. Goldfish reviewers examine the draft and referenced source material without the earlier conversation, helping expose unstated assumptions and blind spots. You make the architectural trade-offs and approve the specification before implementing. Use it when a feature needs design decisions before implementation. For a small, clear bug fix, use your normal coding workflow.

items.detail: No text. No plates. No landmarks. One bridge, one mountain. Located to within 2 m. items.title: kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill
items.subtitle: Local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Cut, captions, reframe, loudness, platform exports. No cloud, no API keys.
items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库
items.author: Python
items.detail: Give your coding agent a video editor. Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client edits your footage with local FFmpeg, then checks its own output. No cloud · No API keys · Python standard library Left half is the input, right half is what the command produced. All 66 before/after demos, with the exact command under each one → — all of it generated from synthetic footage by python3 demos/build.py, so you can rebuild every frame of it yourself. ffmpeg-skill is an Agent Skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and any agent that reads SKILL.md. It teaches the agent a fixed workflow (probe → edit losslessly where possible → check → verify) and ships 42 tools that do the actual work with ffmpeg / ffprobe: cut, join, silence removal, fit to duration and aspect, captions and karaoke, overlays and motion graphics, HDR → SDR and LUTs, audio clean-up and typed dynamics, sync with drift correction, multicam, loudness, delivery checks, whole-edit project rendering, batch folders. Every tool is also callable as an MCP tool (tools/list advertises a core 12 by default to keep client context small, with FFMPEGSKILLMCPFULL=1 listing all 42; every tool is reachable by name through tools/call either way), and the whole set is described by a machine-readable contract.

items.detail: 11 Claude skills for day trading: scan thousands of charts, track breaking news, time every entry and exit, and replay every outcome before you risk a dollar. Free, MIT, no signup, no API key. The tools are plain Python that read free public data: Yahoo Finance charts, Nasdaq Trader's symbol lists, SEC EDGAR and the House Clerk. One scans thousands of charts for setups. Another tracks breaking news on every stock you watch. One watches a setup bar by bar and tells you the moment to get in, and another sets your stop and your target before you do. And the craziest one is the Time Machine: before you risk a dollar, it replays the rest of the session 10,000 times from the stock's own recent bars, plus every past day the same setup fired, and tells you the honest odds.

items.detail: Eleven Claude skills that run a LinkedIn account. Free, MIT, no signup, no API key, nothing to connect. One of them writes your posts off 21 hook formulas. One comments on other people's posts. One handles the replies under yours. One scores your profile out of 100 and rewrites what lost points. One plans the week: what to post, when, and who to engage with. And one is the humanizer, which is the reason the rest are usable. It strips the em dashes, the slop vocabulary and the invisible watermark characters out of a draft, then scores what is left against a five-check detection panel before you ever see it.

items.detail: Claude Code、Codex、CursorをはじめとするAIコーディング環境に読み込ませて使用してください。本体を入れられない環境のために、本体を短くした yomiyasu-mini と yomiyasu-pocket も公開しています（本体を入れられない環境では）。 文章を生成するAIは日常的な道具となりました。 一方で、AIで生成された文章には独特のクセが残りやすく、そのままでは実務や技術発信に使いにくい場面が多くあります。 1. 禁止語の置き換えにとどまる対処 「手触り」「解像度」「泥臭い」といった表層の単語を禁止しても、別の曖昧な語へ置き換わるだけで、不自然な文構造そのものは解消されませんでした。 2. 編集ルールの過剰適用 修辞の規範を与えすぎると、モデルが指示を過剰に解釈し、かえって不自然な造語や大げさな文体を招いていました。 3. 主述関係の曖昧さと非生物主語 誰が何をどうするのかが省略されたまま、概念や道具が比喩的な動詞（壊れる、倒す、効くなど）と結びつき、読み手が文脈を大きく補って読む必要がありました。 4. 形式の偏重と情報密度の低下 太字や箇条書きが増える一方で、手順やコードの仕組みといった核心の部分は抽象的に書かれ、文章の量に比べて実際の情報が少なくなっていました。

items.subtitle: UI design skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI agents: explore distinct directions, compare them side by side, refine against real screenshots. 给 AI Agent 用的 UI 设计 Skill。
items.badge: GitHub · 新创建 Skills 仓库
items.author: Python
items.detail: Oil UI is an interface design skill for AI agents. It explores a few genuinely different design directions side by side, lets you choose one, then refines it against real screenshots. It works for websites, apps, dashboards, and components. See more designs at ui.oiloil.org. 1. Understand what the product is. Before drawing anything, it names the product category, finds two or three peers with the most distinctive styles, and looks at what they do and why. Then it decides what to keep and what to change. 2. Turn “premium” and “clean” into real decisions. Everyone uses these words, but they don't tell you what to put on the screen. It first sets the tone from the subject, audience, and brand voice, such as lively or calm, polished or raw, dense or airy. Then it turns that tone into visible choices: which typefaces, how much white space, and how much of the page uses color. 3. Start each direction from something concrete. That could be a material in its setting, a scene, a character, or the visual language of another field. Ideas come from the product itself, not from adjectives like “minimal” or “bold.” 4. Decide who the first screen is for. On pages where people browse, shop, or get work done, the first screen should be the content itself. Only pages meant to persuade need a designed opening layout, settled before the copy is written. 5. Make the directions truly different. Of

items.detail: Research Solution Supervisor 是一个面向研究型工作的 AI 监督 skill。它不负责把研究重新做一遍，而是判断 AI 的回答、研究 pass 或方案建议是否真正推进了用户的研究目标，并把结论转成下一步可执行动作。 这个 skill 借鉴了 Intent Debugger 的思路：先把目标和判断标准说清楚，再评估当前输出是否满足这些标准。不同点在于，Intent Debugger 更偏“把模糊意图变成可确认需求”，Research Solution Supervisor 更偏“监督 AI 是否让研究方案真的向前走”。 1. 推进判断：当前 AI 工作是否解决了本阶段问题。 2. 关键缺口：哪些缺失、冲突或证据不足会影响继续推进。 3. 下一步动作：下一轮最该做什么，必要时给出可直接发送的 prompt。 4. 当前状态：哪些可以暂时视为成立，哪些仍然不能依赖。

items.detail_en: Research Solutions Manager is an AI skiller for research-oriented work. It is not responsible for re-examining research, but rather for determining whether AI ' s answers, studies pass or programme recommendations really advance the user ' s research objectives and translates the conclusions into next implementable actions. This skill draws on the idea of Intent Debugger: first, to clarify the objective and the judgement criteria, then to assess whether the current output meets them. The difference is that the Intent Debugger prefers "to turn vague intent into an identifiable need" and the Research Solutions Manager favours "supervising AI to make research programmes really move forward." 1. Advance judgement: whether the current AI process has resolved this stage of the problem. 2. Key gaps: what are missing, conflicting or insufficient evidence to influence further progress. 3. Next steps: The next round should do the most, giving, if necessary, a prompt that can be sent directly. 4. Current state: which can be considered valid for the time being and which cannot still be relied upon.

items.title: hajdu-patrik/trirouter
items.subtitle: AI-powered multi-model workspace and routing system for Claude, Codex and other LLM agents. Provides intelligent prompt routing, agent orchestration, evaluation workflows, CLI integrations, MCP tooling and developer productivity automation.
items.author: Python
items.detail: trirouter runs before every prompt you send to Claude Code, OpenAI Codex or Google Antigravity – in every project, in the desktop apps and in remote sessions – and decides for that single request: It also protects running work: a prompt sent while an earlier one is still being processed is told to finish that work first, never stop or overwrite it. Decisions come from JEV (TypeSafe) when you configure a TypeSafe token or an OpenRouter key; without one a built-in local classifier decides, so everything works out of the box. Setup detects the tools, takes an optional JEV key, connects hooks and the MCP server, installs the trirouter command with tab completion, moves every tool's skills into the shared ~/.skills folder (scanned with SkillSpector when installed), generates the worker agents and offers remote access. Every change is shown first, changed config files keep a .bak, re-running is safe.
